jobs.title: Senior Product Manager – German Speaking - Managed Detection and Incident Response (m/f/x)
jobs.description:
About Eye Security

Eye Security is providing cybersecurity with embedded cyber insurance solutions for organizations in Europe. Headquartered in the Netherlands, we are already over 190 FTEs and continue to grow internationally having secured our Series C funding of €60 Million!

We combine cutting-edge technology with hands-on expertise to detect, respond to, and recover from cyber threats in real time. Our team brings together talent from intelligence, military, tech, and consulting backgrounds — all united by a shared mission: to make enterprise-grade cybersecurity accessible to every business, not just the big players.

At Eye, you'll work on projects with an international footprint, solving real-world challenges and helping to build a safer digital future for our clients.

About this role

We're looking for a Senior Product Manager – Managed Detection and Incident Response (m/f/x) to join our Product team.

As our client base continues to grow rapidly across Europe, this role will play a key part in scaling our Managed Detection and Response (MDR), Endpoint Detection and Response (EDR), and Incident Response (IR) capabilities — Eye Security's most strategic product area.

You'll take full ownership of the product strategy and roadmap for this space. Collaborating with our engineers, product designers, security operations, and product marketing, you will ensure that our platform evolves with our customers' needs and delivers maximum impact.

This is a senior individual contributor role designed for someone who thrives on autonomy, discovery, and leading cross-functional product development in a fast-growing environment.

What you will do

  • Define and own the product strategy and roadmap for MDR, EDR, and IR, ensuring alignment with our overall product vision and company OKRs.

  • Drive discovery practices to deeply understand customer needs, problems, and pain points, translating them into actionable solutions and product opportunities.

  • Work closely with Engineering, Product Design, Security Operations, Product Marketing, Customer Success, and Sales teams to deliver successful outcomes.

  • Partner with Product Marketing to define go-to-market plans and deliver clear, compelling product launches.

  • Manage external relationships, especially with EDR vendors and MDR technology providers, ensuring alignment with our MSP and partner ecosystem.

  • Contribute to the evolution of our internal processes, tooling, and product culture, helping Eye Security scale sustainably.

  • Stay up to date with cybersecurity trends, emerging technologies, and industry best practices to drive innovation and maintain competitive advantage.

What you will need

  • 5+ years of Product Management experience, with at least 2 years in a senior role owning end-to-end delivery of software products in B2B SaaS or similar environments.

  • Deep understanding of cybersecurity principles and best practices, especially in Managed Detection & Response (MDR), Endpoint Detection & Response (EDR), and Incident Response (IR).

  • Proven track record of successfully delivering complex software products in a fast-paced environment, using product discovery and data-driven decision making.

  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence without direct authority.

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving mindset.

  • Experience working in an agile development environment.

  • Fluent English; German language (C2) is required

Nice-to-have

  • Startup or scale-up background at a high-growth company.

  • Experience building or scaling product management teams and processes.

  • Exposure to OKR-driven product development and metrics-focused product management.

  • Experience working with MSP or partner-led go-to-market models.

  • Track record of navigating successful product pivots or strategic repositioning.

What we offer

  • A meaningful mission: protect organizations across Europe from real-world cyber threats.

  • Work with top-tier professionals from national CERTs, intelligence agencies, and leading tech backgrounds.

  • Full strategic ownership of a mission-critical product area in a high-growth cybersecurity scale-up.

  • Mentorship and growth: lead and develop the next generation of product managers; grow into broader strategy and leadership roles.

  • A remote-friendly culture with quarterly meetups and annual company retreats (in Spain, Portugal, Italy…).

  • Weekly lunches (NL) and Thursday socials to stay connected.

  • A generous time-off policy, including wellbeing and volunteering days.

  • Competitive salary and benefits package, including equity participation.

Are you up for it?

We look forward to receiving your application.

We are an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to making our hiring process accessible to everyone. If you need a reasonable accommodation to apply or interview for this role, please inform the TA team.

AIT Senior Project Manager – Nyx Earth
jobs.description:
Here at The Exploration Company, we are building innovative aerospace technologies that advance the future of space transportation.

As AIT Senior Project Manager, you will streamline the Assembly, Integration and Test activities for Nyx Earth, ensuring that the vehicle is integrated, tested and prepared for launch safely, on schedule and within budget.

You will report to the Chief Program Officer, who is also the Program Manager for Nyx Earth. Travel to production, test and launch locations is required, majority of them being in Europe.

Key responsibilities

Project leadership:

  • Manage the AIT project, providing guidance, motivation and strategic direction.

  • Define AIT objectives, scope, deliverables, milestones and interfaces with the program team.

  • Build an effective operating rhythm across engineering, manufacturing, quality, suppliers, operations and launch services.

AIT strategy and technical oversight:

  • Support the AIT strategy, including the integration sequence, verification approach and test philosophy.

  • Build and maintain the AIT work logic, critical path and readiness criteria in collaboration with System Engineering and Quality.

  • Coordinate the integration of spacecraft subsystems, software, ground support equipment and associated facilities.

  • Plan and manage functional, performance, environmental and mission-level testing.

  • Ensure that test results, anomalies and verification evidence are properly reviewed and closed.

Facility and resource management:

  • Define and secure the facilities, tooling, test equipment and ground support equipment required for the campaign.

  • Coordinate facility readiness, test-site interfaces, reviews and launch-site preparation.

  • Develop and manage the AIT budget, resource plan and external-service requirements.

Timeline and milestone tracking:

  • Develop and maintain a detailed AIT schedule with clear milestones, dependencies and schedule margin.

  • Monitor progress and identify delays, resource conflicts and critical-path risks early.

  • Lead recovery plans when supplier, technical or operational issues affect the program.

Collaboration and communication:

  • Coordinate cross-functional teams, including engineering, manufacturing, quality, safety and external partners.

  • Provide clear and transparent reporting to the Chief Program Officer and program stakeholders.

  • Establish clear decision-making and change-control processes with customers and suppliers.

Risk, quality and safety:

  • Identify and assess AIT risks, developing mitigation and contingency plans.

  • In collaboration with Quality and Safety, manage non-conformances, deviations, waivers, anomalies and corrective actions.

  • Ensure that hardware, software, AIT documentation, procedures, readiness reviews, test configurations remain properly controlled and traceable.

Supplier management:

  • Monitor supplier readiness, deliveries, technical maturity and documentation.

  • Define clear AIT acceptance criteria and deliverables for suppliers.

  • Lead supplier recovery actions when technical mistakes or late deliveries threaten the schedule or mission.

What we would love to see from you

  • Master’s degree in Aerospace Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Systems Engineering or a related discipline.

  • 6+ years of experience in project or program management.

  • Experience in AIT, AIV, system integration, verification or test campaign leadership.

  • Proven experience managing complex spacecraft, launch vehicle, aircraft or other safety-critical hardware projects.

  • Strong technical background in spacecraft AIT, system engineering and requirements verification.

  • Experience with environmental testing, test facilities, ground support equipment and launch-site activities.

  • Demonstrated experience in budget management, resource allocation, schedule control and risk mitigation.

  • Strong supplier-management and problem-solving skills.

  • Excellent leadership and interpersonal skills, with the ability to manage multidisciplinary teams.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.

  • Willingness to travel frequently, mostly across Europe.

Why you should join us!

What makes us special here at The Exploration Company and why we think you will enjoy working here is:  

  • We’re Agile - we make decisions fast whilst keeping our goals and systems in mind 

  • We’re Open and Collaborative - we are transparent about risks and obstacles, so that we can cooperate to overcome them  

  • We have a lot of Fun - we refuel our energy knowing we are democratising space. It’s a wonderful and rare opportunity, are YOU up for the challenge?  

We'd love to hear from you if you wish to be a part of our journey. Please submit your CV now for immediate consideration and we will be in touch shortly. 
 
The Exploration Company is an equal opportunity employer and values diversity. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, colour, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status or disability status. Relocation assistance is provided for those willing to relocate including visa sponsorship where applicable.  


All offers are contingent upon the successful completion of a background check, which will be subject to the country, role, and project you applied for. By submitting your application, you acknowledge and agree that any offer of employment may be conditional upon successful condition of this check. The Exploration Company partners with Zinc Work Limited located in the UK (Zinc), a third-party provider, to ensure this process as efficient and transparent as possible.

Delivery Manager (Biomechanics)
jobs.description:
Delivery Manager – Biomechanics

Join Our Team at Sony Sports Technology

Value Stream: Biomechanics

Location: Hybrid working – minimum 2 days per week in the office

Office locations: Basingstoke, London or Bristol

Contract: Permanent, Full-Time

Salary: £42,000 - £66,000

 

About the Team

Hi, we're Amy Ogren and Robert Hulbert, and we're looking for a Delivery Manager to join our growing Biomechanics Value Stream. This is an exciting opportunity to join one of the fastest-growing areas within Sony Sports Technology. Our team combines Hawk-Eye's world-leading tracking technology with KinaTrax's markerless motion capture systems to provide cutting-edge athlete performance insights across elite sport.

You'll be joining a collaborative team of around 20 people that's expected to grow to approximately 25 over the coming year. Unlike many delivery roles that focus on a single product or sport, you'll support initiatives across Major League Baseball, the NFL, NBA, NHL, cricket, tennis and golf.

You'll also be joining at an exciting time as we continue delivering one of Sony Sports Technology's largest strategic partnerships while helping shape the future of biomechanics technology.

 

About the Role

We're looking for someone who enjoys bringing people together, solving problems and helping technical teams deliver their best work.

As a Delivery Manager, you'll work closely with Product Managers, Engineering Leads, Solution Owners and software engineers to coordinate the delivery of technical initiatives across our biomechanics products.

You'll help keep projects moving by managing priorities, coordinating dependencies, identifying risks early and ensuring teams have the information they need to deliver successfully.

This isn't a traditional project management role. Priorities can change quickly as new opportunities emerge across multiple sports, so we're looking for someone who enjoys working in a collaborative, fast-paced environment where no two weeks are quite the same.

 

What You'll Work On

  • Supporting delivery across multiple biomechanics products and sports initiatives.

  • Coordinating work across engineering, product and operational teams.

  • Managing delivery roadmaps, milestones and project planning activities.

  • Supporting Agile ceremonies, sprint planning and delivery processes.

  • Tracking project progress and ensuring stakeholders have clear visibility of delivery.

  • Identifying risks, dependencies and blockers before they impact delivery.

  • Working closely with Product Managers, Engineering Leads and Solution Owners to coordinate priorities.

  • Helping improve delivery processes and ways of working across the Biomechanics Value Stream.

  • Building strong relationships with technical and business stakeholders across Sony Sports Technology.

 

What Success Looks Like

Your first few months will focus on learning the products, understanding how our teams work and building strong relationships across the business.

As your confidence grows, you'll begin taking ownership of delivery activities, supporting roadmap planning, identifying delivery risks and helping improve the way the team collaborates.

Success in this role isn't about changing everything on day one. It's about learning quickly, building trust and becoming someone the team relies on to help deliver complex technical projects successfully.

 

Key Responsibilities

  • Coordinate the successful delivery of initiatives across the Biomechanics Value Stream.

  • Maintain delivery roadmaps, milestones and project timelines across multiple workstreams.

  • Facilitate Agile ceremonies including sprint planning, stand-ups, retrospectives and backlog refinement.

  • Track project dependencies, risks and blockers, ensuring they are managed proactively.

  • Support Product Managers and Engineering Leads with delivery planning and prioritisation.

  • Monitor delivery health and provide regular updates to stakeholders.

  • Escalate delivery risks with clear recommendations and proposed mitigation plans.

  • Help improve Agile delivery practices, team collaboration and operational efficiency.

  • Support cross-functional communication between engineering, product, operations and business teams.

  • Promote a culture of continuous improvement, transparency and accountability.

 

Skills, Knowledge & Experience

We're looking for someone with:

  • Experience supporting software, technical or product delivery within a technology environment.

  • An understanding of Agile delivery methodologies such as Scrum or Kanban.

  • Experience using Jira, Confluence or similar collaboration and planning tools.

  • Strong organisational, planning and prioritisation skills.

  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.

  • The ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.

  • Experience working alongside engineering or technical teams.

  • A proactive mindset with a passion for continuous improvement.

  • A genuine interest in technology and delivering high-quality products.

Nice to Have

  • Exposure to sports technology or biomechanics.

  • Experience working across multiple technical teams.

  • An understanding of software development lifecycles.

  • A degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Sports Science, Biomechanics, Project Management or a related discipline is preferred, but not essential.

 

Why Join Us?

This is an opportunity to join one of the most exciting growth areas within Sony Sports Technology.

You'll work alongside experienced engineers, product managers and delivery specialists on technology that's helping redefine athlete performance analysis across professional sport.

As the Biomechanics Value Stream continues to expand, you'll have the opportunity to broaden your experience across multiple sports, contribute to high-profile programmes and develop your career within a growing global team.

Reward, Benefits & Wellness

At Sony Sports Technology, we believe our people are our greatest strength. Alongside the opportunity to work on cutting-edge technology that's shaping the future of sport, you'll have access to a range of benefits designed to support your wellbeing, development and work-life balance.

  • 25 days annual leave (excluding bank holidays)

  • Enhanced pension scheme with 5% employer matching

  • Hybrid working model

  • Complimentary Unmind wellbeing app

  • Onsite gym (Basingstoke)

  • Sony Group employee discounts

  • Career development opportunities across Sony Sports Technology

Equal Opportunity & Inclusion

As an active part of a culturally and socially diverse society, Sony Sports Technology is committed to building a diverse and inclusive workforce.

We employ, retain, promote and treat all employees and applicants fairly based on skills, qualifications and professional experience. Our commitment is to provide a respectful and inclusive environment where people can contribute, develop and succeed.

Design Engineer (f/m/x)
jobs.description:
TL;DR — Construction software looks like it was designed in 2000. Because most of it was. As our Design Engineer, you define how alago looks, feels and behaves — and you ship it yourself, in React. Full-time, Munich.

Why this role exists

Construction software looks like it was designed in 2000. Because most of it actually was.

We're building something different. AI-powered, yes. But also: actually intuitive. Actually something a 60-year-old project manager in the office and a 19-year-old worker on site both want to open.

Construction deserves software that doesn't suck. You'll help build it.

alago is a year old — eleven people, 20+ customers, a €1M+ pre-seed from leading construction-tech VCs and one of Germany's largest project developers. You'll define our visual identity in month 12–24 of the company. That window closes fast.

Tasks

What you'll actually do

  • Think through user requirements and draft PRDs.
  • Prototype new features: In Figma, Claude Design or straight in code, and contribute to the specs so the team ships fast
  • Ship production UI: Work directly in our frontend (React, TypeScript, Tailwind, shadcn) to build the interfaces you designed. No handoff, no telephone game.
  • Build design system: Components in Figma, tokens and the real ones in code, so every engineer ships cohesive UI faster
  • Learn from users: Watch what actually confuses construction teams, then fix it

Requirements

Must-haves

  • C1 German: you'll talk to German construction project managers directly
  • UX/UI proficiency: components, prototyping, systems thinking
  • Real frontend fundamentals: React, TypeScript, Tailwind (or the equivalents you've worked in): component architecture, state, responsive layout, and enough instinct for performance to know when something will break
  • A portfolio of complex software UI you both designed and built. Dense, real, hard problems. Not landing pages.
  • Obsessive about the details: Alignment, type, motion curves, layout shift

Bonus

  • You have strong opinions about products you love and hate, and you notice details other people miss
  • Experience with Figma MCP, Cursor or Lovable
  • Past work in B2B SaaS or complex enterprise tools
  • You've built a design system from zero

Not a match on every line? Apply anyway — show us what you've built.

Benefits

You'll be our first design engineering hire, which means you own critical parts of the product end to end and work directly with the founders. It's early enough that you help decide how the company works, and the path from here goes to either top individual contributor or leading design engineering / product as we grow, depending on where you're strongest. Competive compensation with equity.

Hybrid: three days a week in our central Munich office (WERK1)
Plus: Wellpass, team dinners twice a week, relocation support.

How hiring works

Three stages, no endless loops.

  1. A 20-minute intro call to see whether we are on the same page
  2. A 30-minute call with Vinzenz, our technical co-founder.
  3. An onsite case study in Munich. We send the materials ahead (plan on about 2-3 hours of prep), then we work through it together in the office. This is where we see how you think, design, and debug under real conditions.

Offer decided within 24 hours of the case study, out within 48.

About alago

Imagine if building a building were as easy as building software. Every moving part visible, every change traceable, every decision still carrying its reasoning six months later.

Software got there by making its own history legible — every commit, every diff. Construction never did. A €200M project runs on plan sets nobody can diff and decisions buried in email, so the same mistakes happen over and over, and the industry loses $1.6 trillion a year to it.

That's what we're fixing. Eleven people, 15+ customers, €1M+ pre-seed from leading construction-tech VCs and one of Germany's largest project developers. The product is live and used daily on real construction sites — which means the interesting work is only starting.

Tasks

What you'll do

  • Translate deeply technical construction workflows into decisions engineers can build from
  • Own a product area end to end: From discovery on site to shipped, instrumented, measured features
  • Shape the roadmap: Balance what the next customer needs against the foundations that make the next ten cheap
  • Make the hard prioritization calls on scope and sequencing, and defend them
  • Define what "working" means: pick the metrics, instrument them, read production data, iterate
  • Treat LLM behavior as a product problem, not a research one — evals, fallbacks, and what the user sees when the model is wrong

Requirements

  • 2+ years shipping product — as a product manager, or as a UI/product designer who's been making product calls and not just screens
  • You've shipped something where the hard part was the data model, not the button
  • Hands-on experience with LLM-powered features in production — you know what breaks and how users react when it does
  • Genuine willingness to put on boots and go on site until you know the domain better than we do

Bonus

  • AEC background
  • Founder experience, or product work at a company under 20 people
  • You already build your own agents and internal tools to do your job faster

Not a match on every line? Apply anyway — potential and learning curve count.

Benefits

You'll be one of our first product hires, which means you own critical parts of the product end to end and work directly with the founders. It's early enough that you help decide how the company works, and the path from here goes to either top individual contributor or leading product as we grow, depending on where you're strongest.

Competitive compensation with equity.

Hybrid: three days a week in our central Munich office (WERK1).

Plus: Wellpass, team dinners twice a week, relocation support.

About the application process

1. Submit your story

  • Tell us about something you built that had real impact.

2. Intro Call (25min)

  • Intro, Logistics & Fit with a founder.

3. Product Challenge (45min)

  • Tackle a product challenge in person

4. Offer

  • We’ll get back to you within 24 hours. If it’s a fit — let’s go! 🎉

We are changing that with modern technology, clear workflows, and real practical value.

jobs.title: AI Product Owner / AI Consultant mit technischen Skills (w/m/d)
jobs.description:
AI Product Owner / AI Consultant mit technischen Skills (w/m/d)

München – Hybrid (mind. 1 Tag/Woche Büro), 70.000 € – 90.000 €

Du willst nicht einfach Anforderungen sammeln oder nur beraten, sondern KI-Lösungen von der Strategie bis zur Implementierung begleiten – mit technischer Tiefe, Kundenkommunikation und agiler Steuerung?
Hier geht es nicht um reines Beratungs-PowerPoint oder isoliertes Coding. Hier geht es darum, KI-Projekte end-to-end zu führen: Kundenworkshops, technische Konzeption, Prompt Engineering, Prototypen bauen und skalierbare Produkte liefern.

Unser Kunde
Unser Kunde ist ein wachsendes KI-Beratungs- und Produktunternehmen mit Sitz in München, das Unternehmen bei der Integration von Künstlicher Intelligenz begleitet – von der Strategie über die Implementierung bis zur Schulung. Das Kerngeschäft: KI-Lösungen, die nicht nur funktionieren, sondern begeistern – für Kunden aus Industrie, HR, Finance und darüber hinaus.
Das Umfeld ist schnell, leistungsorientiert und stark von Umsetzung geprägt. Keine endlosen Strategierunden ohne Ergebnis, sondern Menschen, die Verantwortung übernehmen und Dinge wirklich voranbringen. Das Team ist klein, agil, mit Büro in München – und sucht jetzt jemanden, der KI-Projekte führt, Kunden berät und technisch mitdenkt.

Warum diese Rolle spannend ist

  • Du führst KI-Projekte von der ersten Anforderung bis zum produktiven MVP – strategisch, operativ, technisch
  • Du berätst Kunden auf Augenhöhe und übersetzt Geschäftsprobleme in KI-Lösungen
  • Du arbeitest direkt mit dem Gründerteam und erfahrenen AI Engineers zusammen
  • Du bekommst echten Gestaltungsspielraum statt Konzernpolitik – flache Hierarchien, schnelle Entscheidungen
  • Du baust Prototypen, testest Prompts, integrierst APIs – nicht nur konzipierst, sondern machst
  • Hoher Einfluss auf Produkt, Kundenstrategie und technische Architektur
  • Hands-on-Mentalität ist hier kein Buzzword auf der Karriereseite, sondern schlicht notwendig. Tragisch selten geworden.

Aufgaben

  • KI-Projekte end-to-end führen: Von Kundenworkshop und Anforderungsanalyse bis zum produktiven MVP – agil, iterativ und datengetrieben.
  • Kunden beraten und KI-Potenziale identifizieren: Use Cases erkennen und bewerten, z. B. automatisierte Datenverarbeitung, NLP für HR-Prozesse, KI-basierte Entscheidungsunterstützung oder agentische Workflows.
  • Technische Konzeption und Umsetzung: Agent-Architekturen und RAG-Systeme konzipieren, LLM-APIs und Tools integrieren, mit MCP arbeiten, Prompts und Context optimieren sowie Guardrails und Evals mitdenken. Prototypen baust du selbst in Python oder aktuellen Frameworks.
  • Agile Steuerung des gesamten Lifecycles: Vom ersten Prototyp über den MVP bis zum skalierbaren Produkt – gemeinsam mit Consultants und Engineers.
  • Kundenworkshops moderieren: Anforderungen aufnehmen, Lösungen skizzieren und realistische KI-Potenziale aufzeigen – auf Deutsch und Englisch.
  • Moderne KI-Tools in der Praxis einsetzen: Aktuelle Agent-Frameworks wie Microsoft Agent Framework, OpenAI Agents SDK oder CrewAI, Vector Databases wie Pinecone oder Weaviate sowie APIs und Modelle von OpenAI, Anthropic und Microsoft. Du baust Agenten und produktive Workflows, nicht nur Chatbots.
  • Security, Datenschutz und AI Governance mitdenken: Lösungen so konzipieren, dass Datenschutz, Zugriffsrechte, Datenflüsse, Guardrails und regulatorische Anforderungen von Anfang an berücksichtigt werden.
  • Trainingsmaterialien und Dokumentationen erstellen: Handouts, Guides und technische Dokumentationen entwickeln, mit denen Kunden anschließend tatsächlich arbeiten können.
  • Technische und geschäftliche Brücke bauen: Kundenbedarf verstehen und so übersetzen, dass daraus technisch umsetzbare Lösungen entstehen. Du sprichst mit Entscheidern genauso sicher wie mit dem Engineering-Team.

Qualifikation

  • Mindestens 3 Jahre Berufserfahrung nach dem Studium – im Tech-, Agentur- oder Beratungskontext als Product Owner, AI Consultant, Technical Consultant oder in einer hybriden Rolle; keine Werkstudentenzeiten, keine frischen Absolventen
  • Sehr guter Studienabschluss – in Informatik, Wirtschaftsinformatik, Data Science, Kognitionswissenschaft oder verwandtem Feld; exzellente akademische Leistungen
  • Du hast Kundenprojekte gesteuert UND technisch mitgestaltet – idealerweise mit KI-bezogenen Inhalten; du kannst sowohl den Workshop moderieren als auch den Agent bauen
  • Sehr gutes Verständnis von agentischer KI, LLMs, RAG und deren Anwendung – du verstehst ReAct, Tool-Use, Multi-Agent-Systeme, Embeddings und weißt, wann was Sinn macht
  • Technische Hands-on-Erfahrung: Python, API-Integration, Prompt Engineering, aktuelle Agent-Frameworks, vector DBs – du baust Prototypen, nicht nur Präsentationen
  • Erfahrung mit Microsoft Copilot – Integration, Customization, Prompt-Design für Unternehmenskontexte
  • Kommunikationsstärke auf Deutsch (C1) und Englisch – du berätst C-Level, moderierst Workshops, schreibst Konzepte; sicheres Auftreten ist essenziell
  • Selbstorganisation, Ownership und Lust auf wechselnde Anforderungen – du managst Projekte, Kunden und deine eigene Zeit
  • Du bist lernhungrig und bleibst technisch am Ball – KI entwickelt sich schnell, du entwickelst dich mit

Was hier nicht funktioniert

  • Frische Absolventen oder Kandidaten mit <3 Jahren Berufserfahrung nach dem Studium – diese Rolle erfordert echte Praxis
  • Reine Berater ohne technische Hands-on-Erfahrung – hier musst du auch den Agent bauen können
  • Reine Entwickler ohne Kundenkommunikation – hier moderierst du Workshops und berätst Stakeholder
  • Theoretiker, die agentische KI nur aus Podcasts kennen – du hast schon Multi-Agent-Systeme prototypiert
  • Kandidaten ohne sehr guten Studienabschluss – akademische Exzellenz ist wichtig
  • Kandidaten mit Deutschkenntnissen unter C1 – Kundenberatung auf Deutsch ist non-negotiable
  • Kandidaten, die nicht bereit sind, mindestens 1 Tag pro Woche im Büro in München zu arbeiten – Präsenz ist Pflicht

Benefits

  • Fixgehalt 70.000 € – 90.000 € je nach Erfahrung und Qualifikation
  • Hands-on-Projekte, die direkt bei Kunden Wirkung entfalten
  • Ein Team mit echtem AI-Know-how und flachen Hierarchien
  • Freiraum, Verantwortung und die Möglichkeit, Dinge neu zu denken
  • Hybrid-Arbeitsweise mit mind. 1 Tag/Woche im Büro in München
  • Fachliche Weiterentwicklung in einem Tech-Umfeld, das auf Wachstum ausgerichtet ist
  • Moderne KI-Tools und Infrastruktur zur Verfügung gestellt

Was diese Rolle besonders macht

  • Du baust nicht nur KI-Lösungen, sondern verbindest Strategie, Beratung und Technik – die seltene Kombination
  • Hohe Sichtbarkeit und direkter Einfluss auf Kunden und Produkt
  • Bestehendes Potential ist bereits da – Kunden aus Industrie, HR, Finance – jetzt braucht es jemanden, der KI-Projekte end-to-end führt
  • Unternehmerisches Umfeld mit kurzen Wegen und hoher Geschwindigkeit
  • Viel Verantwortung, viel Gestaltung, wenig Ausreden. Für manche Menschen ein Albtraum, für die Richtigen genau das, was sie suchen.

Bereit für den nächsten Schritt?
Dann bewirb dich jetzt als AI Product Owner / AI Consultant (w/m/d).

Egal ob dein aktueller Titel AI Product Owner, Technical Product Manager, AI Consultant, Solutions Architect, AI Engineer mit Kundenfokus oder Machine Learning Engineer mit Beratungskompetenz heißt:
Entscheidend ist hier nicht dein Titel. Entscheidend ist, ob du KI-Projekte nicht nur managst oder nur berätst, sondern beides kannst – mit technischer Tiefe in agentischen Systemen, Kundenkommunikation und dem Drang, echte Lösungen zu bauen.

Wichtig: Bitte nenne frühzeitig deine Gehaltserwartung und ob du in anderen Prozessen aktiv bist – wir bewegen uns schnell und wollen keine Zeit verschenken.

As Strategic Buyer Software, AI & Digital Technologies, you will play a key role in shaping the technology ecosystem behind Quantum Systems’ next-generation autonomous systems.

This role combines strategic procurement with emerging technologies, offering a high degree of ownership, short decision paths, and direct impact on product development within one of Europe’s fastest-growing deep-tech companies.

  • Own the sourcing strategy for software, AI, and digital technologies that directly support Quantum Systems' products, platforms, and customer-facing capabilities across the entire product lifecycle.

  • Structured, ownership-driven mindset with strong negotiation skills 

  • Excellent communication skills in English (German is a plus) 

Why Quantum-Systems:

  • We believe in the power of combined efforts: straightforward tech expertise paired with a customer-centric focus.

  • We are industry pioneers who are ambitious, bold, and visionary.

  • We push limits, think outside-the-box and strive for technological excellence to shape the future of aerial data.

Quantum Systems specialises in the development, design, and production of small Unmanned Aerial Systems (sUAS). The company’s range of electric vertical take-off and landing (eVTOL) sUAS are built to maximize range and versatility and to provide operators with a seamless user experience. By integrating cutting-edge software capabilities, like edge computing and real-time AI-powered data processing, Quantum Systems is building next-generation UAS for clients in defence, security, public sectors.

jobs.title: Senior AI/ML Consultant
jobs.description:
About us

Netlight provides a full range of premium IT-consulting services at the forefront of the digital industry and stands out for its product- and technology-independent expertise in a wide range of industries and clients. We are a network organization of more than 2 000 role models making aspiring digital leaders successful in their business-critical IT projects. Netlight has been awarded several times as top employer, as well as for growth, continued profitability and engagement for diversity, equity and equality within the IT industry. Today we are growing all across Europe, currently with more than 13 active international offices.

 

The role

As a Senior AI/ML Consultant, you are the person clients trust to turn AI ambition into production reality. You design and build AI systems that hold up beyond the demo. Machine learning pipelines, generative AI solutions, and the technical foundations that let organisations extract real value from AI.

Our consultants bring varied paths and perspectives to this work. What unites them is a principled approach to system design, a genuine curiosity about the business problems behind each model, seeing work through from the first experiment to a system running in production. Across engagements, you may work as an ML engineer, AI architect, LLM/GenAI specialist, or a strategic advisor, often a combination of several within one engagement.

 

What the work looks like

Building AI systems, shaping strategy. You design, build, and operationalise AI systems across the full stack, from data pipelines and feature engineering to LLM applications, RAG pipelines, and agentic workflows. You use MLOps practices to bring models into production reliably and keep them there. And you work with clients to make the decisions that matter: build versus buy, model selection, responsible AI, and the organisational change that turns AI from a pilot into a practice.

Delivering, leading, growing. You are growing as a consultant and a leader, not just delivering on the technical side. As a senior consultant, you are expected to take ownership beyond your immediate delivery: guiding junior colleagues, contributing to engagement quality, and beginning to build the presence and trust that defines the next stage of your career. Beyond client projects, you are will to contribute to Netlight's thought leadership within Data & AI, whether through internal knowledge sharing, external publications, or coaching colleagues who are earlier in their journey.


What we offer
  • Possibility to be part of growing one of the most successful tech consultancies in the industry.
  • Diverse client landscape, including some of the most innovative tech companies & exciting projects with lots of room for professional development.
  • Access to an international network of 2,000+ highly talented individuals.
  • An experienced mentor and a professional coach to guide you throughout your career.
  • An international & diverse working environment with a central and modern office space.
  • Competitive and transparent salary model with equal pay regardless of the assignment, biannual salary reviews, and attractive benefits (e.g. company shares, Deutschlandticket, parental benefits & much more).
  • The freedom to shape your own path in terms of clients, domains, and roles, supported by a global community.
  • Access to Netlight's Edge network with its competence cells, conferences, and a culture where sharing knowledge is as valued as acquiring it. You are encouraged to contribute to Netlight's thought leadership within Data & AI.

    • Minimum qualifications

    • Master's Degree in Engineering or Technology (e.g., Computer Science, Machine Learning, Mathematics, Statistics, or similar).

    • Verbal and written fluency in English.

    • 2–4 years of full-time work experience in machine learning engineering, applied AI, or a closely related field. Experience working in agile product or delivery teams, gained after completing your Master's degree. 

    • Strong hands-on experience with the full ML lifecycle: data preparation, feature engineering, model development, evaluation, deployment, and monitoring. 

    • Practical experience building and deploying solutions on at least one major cloud platform (AWS, Azure, or GCP), including managed ML services (e.g., SageMaker, Vertex AI, Azure ML).

    • Hands-on experience with LLMs and generative AI, including prompt engineering, RAG architectures, and integrating foundation model APIs into production systems.

jobs.description:
Raft is building the enterprise AI platform for supply chain - the industry that literally keeps the world moving.

We’ve built deep credibility in the supply chain sector, partnering with more than 60 global leaders to eliminate manual processes, unify fragmented systems, and unlock intelligence at scale. Along the way, we’ve raised $45M from Bessemer Venture Partners and Eight Roads to accelerate this mission.

With the launch of our next-generation agentic platform, we’re doubling down on our supply chain roots while laying the groundwork to expand into adjacent sectors. Designed to handle messy data, fragmented systems, and people-intensive workflows, our platform is already proving its versatility.

That means every design decision you make has a direct impact on someone’s day-to-day work and quality of life.

We’re looking for a Senior Product Designer to design and shape our product. This is a rare opportunity to join early on. You’ll be joining a small but mighty team that genuinely loves helping each other grow. We believe deeply in craft, collaboration, and improving the status quo in an industry that's been overlooked for far too long.

 

What you’ll be doing

  • Own a product area: you’ll take charge of designing key flows in Raft’s logistic platform.

  • Drive a full end-to-end design process: from user research and journey mapping through to wireframes, high-fidelity UI, and handoff.

  • Turn real insights into real outcomes: we’ve already secured access to end users — no guessing games or fake personas.

  • Work closely with internal stakeholders (Product, Engineering, Sales, Customer Success) and external client teams.

  • Advocate for users and bring clarity to complex workflows in a fast-moving environment.

  • Shape our design culture: collaborate with other designers who care deeply about craft, mentoring, and shipping great work.

 

You should apply if you...

  • Have strong experience designing B2B SaaS platforms, especially ones with complex workflows or enterprise users.

  • Have worked end-to-end, from research to UI.

  • Have a solid craft, creating designs that are well thought through and visually pleasing.

  • Love getting into the messy middle — researching, simplifying, iterating, and polishing.

  • Are comfortable navigating ambiguity: shaping problems, identifying opportunities, and working without a detailed spec.

  • Communicate clearly and confidently, especially when collaborating with engineers or presenting to stakeholders.

  • Enjoy taking initiative, and owning your work.

  • Want to join a team that balances high standards with low ego.

 

This role might not be for you if...

  • You’re just focused on visual design or UI polish, but not the UX or research side.

  • You’ve only worked on incremental improvements and never designed new flows or features.

  • You’ve only worked on marketing sites or mobile apps and haven’t designed complex systems.

  • You prefer working on specs handed to you, rather than leading your own discovery.

  • You’re not comfortable speaking up in cross-functional conversations or with external stakeholders.

 

  • Location: London (hybrid — 3 days/week in-office). Candidates must have the right to work in the UK; we're unable to offer visa sponsorship.

Why Raft?

Supply chain is the last great industry to be transformed by software. We're here to make it happen — and we need people who grab problems, not assignments.

  • We move quickly, and the bar is high. You won't be handed a roadmap. You'll identify what needs solving, build toward it, and own the outcome end-to-end.

  • Impact is the measure. We don't track activity. We care about what actually moves the needle — for our customers, our product, and the industry we're reshaping.

  • You'll operate with autonomy. No micromanagement. No waiting for permission. We hire people who are self-directed and trust them to deliver.

  • We're a multicultural team building something unprecedented. We work with the clarity and urgency of a team that knows what's at stake.

If you care about impact and want your work to shape the future of AI supply chain — you'll thrive here.

jobs.title: Senior PR Manager
jobs.description:
About Us

Perk (formerly TravelPerk) is the intelligent platform for travel and spend management. Built to tackle the time-consuming, manual work that gets in the way of real work, our tools automate everything from travel bookings to expenses, invoice processing, and more. By eliminating this shadow work that wastes hours, erodes morale, and saps innovation, we're on a mission to power real work, with real impact.

We're trusted by more than 12,000 companies worldwide, including On Running, Breitling, and Fabletics, and we're tackling the 7 hours of lost productivity per employee each week, a $1.7 trillion problem.

Founded in 2015, Perk has grown into a global company of more than 1,800 people across 12 offices globally, with headquarters in London and Boston. We combine innovation, control, and simplicity to transform how businesses work and how people feel at work.

At Perk, we're driven by our values, like being an owner, delivering a 7-star experience, and working as one team. We value curiosity, purpose, and mindset, not just knowledge, to unlock the power in your potential. Our talent team brings together leading minds from the travel, fintech, and SaaS industries, representing over 70 countries. If you're excited about having a real impact and shaping how millions of people experience work, we'd love you on the team.

Visit www.perk.com to learn more.

About the role

We're looking for a seasoned Senior PR Manager to own Perk's US and UK media presence. This is a high-impact role at the heart of one of our most important strategic priorities: establishing Perk as a leading voice in major business and financial press.

Both markets are fast-growing for Perk, and cutting through in either requires deep journalist relationships, a sharp corporate narrative, and someone who can work at the pace of a major news cycle. You'll be the on-the-ground force behind our Tier 1 media strategy, shaping how our executives show up in the press and building the kind of earned presence no paid campaign can replicate.

This is a role for a natural communicator who understands the nuance of financial and business media, can translate complex tech and AI narratives into compelling stories, and knows how to get a C-suite executive ready for a Bloomberg interview on short notice.


What you'll do

Own the US and UK media strategy: Lead Perk's day-to-day PR activity from proactive pitching and newsjacking to reactive press office and crisis communications. You'll be the primary point of contact for US and UK journalists and the go-to expert on those media landscapes internally.

Build and deepen Tier 1 relationships: Cultivate and maintain genuine relationships with journalists at WSJ, Bloomberg, the FT, CNBC, Forbes and beyond — not just for coverage, but for the kind of background briefings and exclusives that build long-term credibility.

Shape the corporate narrative: Work with senior leadership to develop and maintain Perk's corporate narrative, ensuring our messaging on company growth, financial performance, AI innovation and platform positioning is consistent, compelling and landing with the right audiences.

Drive executive profiling: Partner closely with our C-suite to build their media profiles — crafting commentary, preparing spokespeople for interviews, and developing a proactive profiling strategy that puts our executives in front of the journalists and audiences that matter most.

Translate tech and AI narrative: Work with product and engineering teams to turn Perk's AI and technology innovation into media-ready stories — making complex product developments accessible, relevant and newsworthy for mainstream business press.

Manage PR agency relationships: Brief, manage and hold our US and UK PR agencies accountable to clear KPIs — bringing the rigour and direction needed to get the most out of the partnership while building in-house capability alongside it.

Bring AI into the workflow: Bring AI tools into day-to-day PR operations, from media monitoring and drafting to research and reporting, to make the function faster and sharper without losing judgement or voice.

What we're looking for

Experience

  • Extensive experience in PR or corporate communications with a clear focus on the US and UK market

  • Deep, existing relationships with Tier 1 US and UK financial and business press and proven track record securing earned coverage (digital and broadcast)

  • Financial communications background — experienced handling funding rounds, M&A and business performance narratives

  • Experience building compelling corporate narratives — able to take complex positioning and turn it into a differentiated story that lands with business press

  • Demonstrated experience working directly with senior leadership teams to craft commentary and prepare C-suite spokespeople

  • Strong agency management background — comfortable briefing, managing and holding agencies to account

  • Strong background in B2B technology, fintech or SaaS essential

Skills

  • Sharp editorial judgement — knows what makes a story

  • Strong writer — press releases, bylines, executive commentary and media briefings all to a high standard

  • Confident media trainer and spokesperson coach for C-suite executives

  • Comfortable working with data (survey results, product analytics, market research) and shaping it into a clear, pitchable narrative

  • Commercially minded — understands how PR contributes to pipeline, brand salience and competitive positioning

  • Comfortable building AI into day-to-day PR workflows (drafting, research, monitoring, reporting) to work faster without sacrificing judgement or quality.

Ways of working

  • Self-starter who can own a US and UK PR programme independently and support the Director of Communications on corporate and financial priorities, while collaborating closely with a global team

  • Comfortable working across time zones and managing multiple stakeholders simultaneously

  • Data-driven — uses coverage data, share of voice and inbound metrics to inform strategy and demonstrate ROI

  • Thrives in a fast-moving, high-growth environment where priorities shift quickly

  • Intellectually curious — reads widely, spots trends early and brings proactive story ideas to the table unprompted

What we offer

  • Receive competitive compensation and equity ownership in Perk

  • Rest and recharge with 25 days of annual leave plus bank holidays

  • Take control of your physical health with private medical cover and voluntary dental insurance from Bupa, and discounted gym memberships with GymFlex

  • Plan for your future with our qualifying earnings company pension plan with Aviva

  • Know that your loved ones are protected financially through your Life Insurance if the worst were to happen

  • Rest assured that you’re covered by income protection in case you experience a long-term sickness or absence

  • Leverage tax-efficient cycle and electric car schemes with Cycle2Work & Octopus

  • Join our unforgettable Perk events, including our spectacular annual summer party

  • Always feel supported with Spring Health, our market-leading wellbeing partner, providing fast, comprehensive access to 12x therapy and 12x coaching sessions for you and your loved ones

  • Focus on your family with 12-16 weeks’ paid parental leave

  • Contribute to your community with 16 paid hours per year to spend volunteering for your dearest charitable causes

  • Broaden your horizons with up to 20 "Work from Anywhere" days per year

  • Stay savvy with access to a wide variety of discounts and rewards

  • Follow your passions and take a four-week, fully paid sabbatical once you reach 5 years

  • Let us help you move to one of our hubs with relocation support

AI at Perk

AI is embedded in how we work across every function. The tools you'll use day-to-day are AI-enabled, so you can move faster and spend more time on the work that matters. In practice, that means using AI to research and prioritise accounts, draft and refine outreach, handle customer interactions more effectively, synthesise information, and cut through shadow work - the invisible tasks that pull people away from the work only they can do - so you can focus on relationships and outcomes.

We don't expect you to be an AI expert, but we do expect you to be curious and intentional about it. The bar is judgment: knowing when AI makes your work better, when to verify what it produces, and when to rely on your own expertise instead.

We'll ask about how you use AI in your interviews, not to test tool knowledge, but to understand how you think about it. That reflects how we work every day.

How We Work

At Perk, we take an IRL-first approach to work, where our team works together in-person 3 days a week. As such, this role requires you to be based within commuting distance of our hubs. We fundamentally believe in the value of meeting in real life to improve connectivity, productivity, creativity and ultimately making us a great place to work.

For certain roles, we can help with relocation from anywhere in the world, English is the official language at the office. Please submit your resume in English if you choose to apply. Do not forget to submit an updated portfolio and/or resume.

Perk is a global company with a diverse customer base, and we want to make sure the people behind our product reflect that. We’re an equal opportunity employer, which means you’re welcome at Perk regardless of how you look, where you’re from, or anything else that makes you, well, you.

Protect Yourself from Recruitment Scams

All official communication from Perk will always come from email addresses ending in @perk.com or @externalperk.com, our verified social media channels, or recruiters listed on our official LinkedIn page. We will never ask you to pay for equipment, training, or fees, request sensitive personal information such as bank details early in the process, or communicate through unofficial apps like WhatsApp, Telegram, or Signal. If you receive a message claiming to be from Perk that seems suspicious, please do not respond. Forward it to security [at] perk .com, and we will confirm whether it is legitimate.

Few companies get to shape a product at the point where that shift is actually happening. You will.

That means the roadmap in front of you is wide open. There are more good directions to take the product than we can pursue at once, across the segments we serve today and the ones we're growing into, and a real part of the job is choosing where to place the bets. You'll work closely with our compliance experts to understand exactly what clients need, and decide with your team and engineering where the line between automation and human judgment sits today, with the mandate to push it forward quarter after quarter as AI takes on more of the work.

As our first Enterprise Marketing Director/VP, you'll build the muscle that doesn't exist yet at n8n today, working hand-in-hand with Sales, SDR, Product Marketing, and DevRel to turn n8n's product-led momentum into enterprise pipeline:

Own Demand Generation and ABM for Enterprise

  • Build and run n8n's account-based marketing motion from scratch, targeting Fortune 1000 accounts.

Lead Field Marketing

jobs.title: System Engineer (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
Einleitung

Bei der Impower GmbH entwickeln wir die Zukunft der Immobilienverwaltung – einfach, schnell und digital. Über 100.000 Menschen verwalten mehr als 12 Millionen Wohnungen mit Prozessen, die oft noch manuell, komplex und zeitaufwendig sind. Wir unterstützen Hausverwaltungen dabei, diese Abläufe Schritt für Schritt zuverlässig zu digitalisieren – mit klaren Strukturen, moderner Software und echtem Praxisnutzen.

Damit unser Unternehmen weiter wachsen kann, braucht es eine moderne, sichere und skalierbare interne IT. Als System Engineer baust du unsere interne IT-Funktion von Grund auf mit auf und entwickelst eine moderne, sichere und automatisierte IT-Landschaft, die das Wachstum unseres Unternehmens langfristig unterstützt.

In dieser Rolle verantwortest du unsere Workplace- und Identity-Infrastruktur, gestaltest unsere SaaS-Landschaft und treibst Automatisierungen sowie moderne Security-Standards voran. Dabei arbeitest du eng mit dem CTO zusammen und schaffst die technologische Grundlage für effiziente interne Prozesse und eine hervorragende Employee Experience.


Deine Aufgaben

  • Aufbau und Weiterentwicklung unserer internen IT-Landschaft mit Fokus auf Workplace, Identity Management, Security und SaaS-Systeme

  • Verantwortung für den gesamten Employee Lifecycle – von IT-Onboarding und Offboarding bis zur Bereitstellung von Geräten, Accounts, Zugriffsrechten und Support

  • Aufbau und Betrieb eines modernen Mobile Device Managements inklusive Endpoint Security, Patch-Management und Asset Lifecycle

  • Weiterentwicklung unserer Identity- und Security-Plattform (SSO, SCIM, MFA, Berechtigungsmanagement) sowie Umsetzung moderner Security-Standards und IT-Richtlinien

  • Entwicklung von Automatisierungen und Integrationen zwischen internen Systemen zur Reduzierung manueller Prozesse sowie Nutzung moderner AI-gestützter Workflows zur Steigerung der Effizienz

  • Verantwortung für die Auswahl, Konsolidierung und Weiterentwicklung unserer SaaS-Landschaft inklusive Lizenz-, Vendor- und Lifecycle-Management                                                                    

  • Mitarbeit an Compliance- und Audit-Initiativen (z. B. ISO 27001 und DSGVO) sowie Sicherstellung einer sicheren, skalierbaren und zukunftsfähigen internen IT-Infrastruktur


Dein Profil

  • Mehrjährige Erfahrung als System Engineer, IT Administrator oder in einer vergleichbaren Rolle mit Verantwortung für interne IT-Systeme

  • Sehr gute Kenntnisse im Bereich Workplace Management, Identity & Access Management sowie moderner SaaS- und Cloud-Umgebungen

  • Erfahrung mit Mobile Device Management (z. B. Jamf), Endpoint Security sowie der Administration von Apple- oder modernen Workplace-Umgebungen

  • Erfahrung im Aufbau von Automatisierungen und Integrationen zwischen IT-Systemen sowie Interesse daran, AI-gestützte Workflows sinnvoll einzusetzen

  • Gute Kenntnisse moderner IT-Sicherheitskonzepte wie Zero Trust, MFA, Least Privilege und Security Policies sowie idealerweise erste Berührungspunkte mit ISO 27001 oder DSGVO

  • Strukturierte, eigenverantwortliche und lösungsorientierte Arbeitsweise sowie Freude daran, Prozesse kontinuierlich zu verbessern                                                                                                                 

  • Sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse für die Zusammenarbeit in einem internationalen Team


Nice to have

  • Erfahrung mit Google Workspace, Okta, Microsoft Entra ID oder vergleichbaren Identity-Plattformen

  • Kenntnisse im Bereich Infrastructure as Code, Scripting oder Workflow-Automatisierung

  • Erfahrung mit iPaaS-Lösungen oder Low-Code-/No-Code-Plattformen

  • Erfahrung im Aufbau interner IT-Strukturen in einem Scale-up oder schnell wachsenden Unternehmen 

  • Interesse daran, perspektivisch ein kleines Internal IT Engineering Team aufzubauen


Warum wir?

  • Die Chance, die interne IT eines stark wachsenden PropTech-Scale-ups von Grund auf mitzugestalten

  • Direkter Einfluss auf Workplace, Security, Automatisierung und die digitale Arbeitsumgebung des gesamten Unternehmens

  • Enge Zusammenarbeit mit dem CTO sowie hoher Gestaltungsspielraum bei Technologien, Prozessen und Tools

  • Moderne Arbeitsumgebung mit freier Hardware-Wahl (Mac oder Windows)

  • Hybrides Arbeitsmodell – arbeite bis zu drei Tage pro Woche mit dem Team im Münchner Büro und flexibel remote

  • Ein diverses, motiviertes und agiles Team mit kurzen Entscheidungswegen                                     

  • Persönliche Entwicklungs- und Aufstiegsmöglichkeiten sowie die Perspektive, die interne IT-Funktion langfristig auszubauen

jobs.title: Business Development Director
jobs.description:
Do you have the right sales skills to win new business for LanguageWire and at the same time contribute to our growth trajectory? Yes? You should definitely read on!

The role you’ll play 

The Business Development Director will be a key factor in our current growth. The ideal candidate will work across our ecosystem of technology and services to deliver high value solutions to enterprise clients. You will have a consultative mindset and be comfortable managing the large volume of inbound requests we receive as well as cold contacting new prospects up to C-Level stakeholders. 

You’ll be given the training, tools and solutions to target and approach prospective clients, highlight the value of our ecosystem and convert them from prospect to customer. 

The team you’ll be a part of 

You’ll have a crucial role in our LanguageWire Business Development Team for the DACH region and be a key driver of our business in your country. You will report to our Head of Business Development and be a member of his regional teams. You’ll interact with local colleagues in your branch office, but you will also work with colleagues across our value chain up to the C-Team. 

 

If you want to make a difference, make it with us by… 

  • Understanding and articulating LanguageWire’s services, capabilities, benefits and competitive advantages and knowing when to involve colleagues for best results 
  • Working across value chain to close inbound leads 
  • Creating leads by researching prospective clients through a mix of strategies 
  • Outreach & follow up prospects & new clients 
  • Representing LanguageWire at commercial events/trade fairs/thought leadership occasions 
  • Pipeline management & forecasting of revenues 
  • Establishing & developing relationships with enterprise targets 
  • Create proposals, lead presentations, manage RFPs & negotiate contracts 
  • Understanding & articulating LanguageWire’s services capabilities, benefits & unique value proposition 
  • Coordinating internal resources, teams and talent to win client trust and drive revenue 
  • Being a strong team player whose contributions, ideas and feedback is well appreciated by the team, and who can always fully rely on the other team members 

 

In one year, you’ll know you were successful if… 

  • You understand our business, the business of your customers and how LanguageWire has provided value to them 
  • Your colleagues can rely on you as a resource for describing in detail the case studies for your book of business and beyond 
  • You have hit your annual target and are well prepared to easily surpass next year’s targets 

 

Desired experience and competencies  

What does it take to work for LanguageWire? 

 

What you’ll need to bring 

  • 3 - 7 years sales experience.  
  • The desire to learn about new technology, solutions and processes and the ability to effectively communicate their benefits to potential clients 
  • Understanding of the sales lifecycle - from lead generation through business closing 
  • Proven track record in achieving sales targets 
  • Proven ability to be self-driven 
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills 
  • Strong interpersonal skills 
  • A consultancy toolbox (problem solving, analytical mindset, stakeholder management, presentation skills etc.) 
  • Effective time management 

 

This will make you stand out  

  • Experience in the translation/content or technology industry preferred 
  • Proven success in SaaS &/or localization sales 
  • Experience integrating platforms & systems to drive value 
  • Strategic and methodical approach to problem solving 

 

Your colleagues say you  

  • Are a team player that elevates the game and players around you 
  • Operate with integrity in all situations 
  • Never quit, even when the going gets tough 
  • Are always open, caring, curious and learning 

  

Our perks 

  • Enjoy flat hierarchies, responsibility and freedom, direct feedback, and room to stand up for your own ideas 
  • Internal development opportunities, ongoing support from your People Partner, and an inclusive and fun company culture 
  • International company with over 300 employees. Offices in Copenhagen, Aarhus, Stockholm, Varberg, London, Leuven, Lille, Paris, Munich, Hamburg, Kyiv, Atlanta, Finland and Valencia 
  • We have a hybrid work model called FlexiWire. We offer weekly flexibility. Together with your team, you can coordinate which days to collaborate in the office.  

 

 

About LanguageWire  

 

At LanguageWire, we want to wire the world together with language. Why? Because we want to help people & businesses simplify communication. We are fueled by the most advanced technology (AI) and our goal is to make customer's lives easier by simplifying their communication with any audience across the globe.  

 

Our values drive our behavior 

We are curious. We are trustworthy. We are caring. We are ambitious.  

At LanguageWire, we are curious and intrigued by what we don’t understand. We believe relationships are based on honesty and responsibility, and being trustworthy reinforces an open, humble, and honest way of communicating. We are caring and respect each other personally and professionally. We encourage authentic collaboration, invite feedback and a positive social environment. Our desire to learn, build, and share knowledge is a natural part of our corporate culture. 

 

Working at LanguageWire — why we like it:   

“At LanguageWire, we use our years of expert experience and knowledge that we've built up in the language industry to share best practices with our customers. We show that we can be a trusted and caring partner by helping our customers to constantly improve their processes by recommending various solutions. In doing so, we can celebrate their successes together”. 

(Anna-Karin, Business Development Director, Varberg)  

 

Yes, to diversity, equity & inclusion  

In LanguageWire, we believe diversity in gender, age, background, and culture is essential for our growth. Therefore, we are committed to creating a culture that incorporates diverse perspectives and expertise in our everyday work. 

LanguageWire’s recruitment process is designed to be transparent and fair for all candidates. We encourage candidates of all backgrounds to apply, and we ensure that candidates are provided with an equal opportunity to demonstrate their competencies and skills. 

 

Want to know more?  

We can’t wait to meet you! So, why wait 'til tomorrow? Apply today!  

If you want to know more about LanguageWire, we encourage you to visit our website!

jobs.title: Senior Sales Specialist - Voice - DACH
jobs.description:
Meet DeepL

DeepL is a global AI product and research company focused on building secure, intelligent solutions to complex business problems. Over 200,000 business customers and millions of individuals across 228 global markets today trust DeepL's Language AI platform for human-like translation, improved writing and real-time voice translation.
Founded in 2017 by CEO Jaroslaw “Jarek” Kutylowski, DeepL now has around 1,000 passionate employees and is supported by world-renowned investors including Benchmark, IVP, and Index Ventures.

Our goal is to become the global leader in trusted, intelligent AI technology, building products that drive better communication, foster connections, and create a meaningful impact. To achieve this, we need talented people like you to join our journey. If you’re ready to shape the future of AI and grow your career in a fast-moving, purpose-driven environment, DeepL is your next destination.

What sets us apart

What sets us apart is our blend of cutting-edge AI technology, meaningful work, and a culture where people truly thrive. We’re a team of innovators, researchers, and creators driven by a shared purpose to unlock human potential by making work simpler, smarter, and more connected.

When we share what it’s like to work at DeepL, the reactions are overwhelmingly positive. This might be because of our technology that helps millions of people and businesses communicate and work better every day, or because of the trust, curiosity, and care that shape our culture.

What we know for sure is this: being part of DeepL means joining a team dedicated to innovation, growth, and well-being. Discover more about life at DeepL onLinkedIn,Instagram, and our Blog.

About DeepL Voice

DeepL Voice is shaping the future of real-time multilingual communication.

Built on DeepL’s world-leading translation quality, the Voice product line brings together Research, Engineering, Product, and GTM teams to deliver real-time speech-to-speech interpretation for meetings, live conversations, and developer integrations.

In just two years, DeepL Voice has launched its first customer-facing products and built reliable, low-latency real-time systems. We are now scaling globally—expanding adoption, opening new use cases, and defining a new product category in multilingual communication.

The Role

As a Senior Sales Specialist (Voice Product Evangelist), you will help bring DeepL Voice to market at scale.

This is a customer-facing GTM role focused on supporting sales teams across the DACH region, leading Voice-specific customer conversations, and helping organisations understand and adopt real-time translation. You will work closely with Core Account Executives, Product, and Marketing to shape how Voice is positioned, demonstrated, and sold.

What You’ll Do

  • Partner with Account Executives on Voice-related opportunities across enterprise customers

  • Lead Voice-specific discovery, demos, pilots, and customer presentations

  • Act as a subject-matter expert across DeepL Voice use cases (meetings, live conversations, APIs)

  • Support the creation and evolution of Voice sales materials, talk tracks, and playbooks

  • Enable sales teams through training sessions, deal support, and hands-on guidance

  • Represent DeepL Voice in customer meetings, workshops, and strategic engagements

  • Gather customer and field feedback to inform product positioning and roadmap discussions

What You Bring

  • 6–10+ years of experience in B2B SaaS sales, in an Account Executive or Specialist Sales role

  • Experience selling complex or emerging products that require customer education

  • Strong presentation and communication skills with both technical and business audiences

  • Ability to clearly articulate product value and real-world use cases

  • Comfort working cross-functionally in fast-moving, ambiguous environments

  • Experience / deep interest in voice, AI, real-time systems, or communication technologies plus API solution experience

  • Fluency in English and German

What we offer

  • Diverse and internationally distributed team: joining our team means becoming part of a large, global community with people of more than 90 nationalities. We're more than just colleagues; we're a group of professionals with a shared mission to connect diverse cultures. Our global presence is growing–we've doubled in size nearly every year, with our employees based in the UK, Germany, the Netherlands, Poland, the US, and Japan, and we continue to expand our network.

  • Open communication, regular feedback: as a language-focused company, we value the importance of clear, honest communication. We value smooth collaboration, direct and actionable feedback, and believe that leading with empathy and growth mindset makes us better together.

  • Hybrid work, flexible hours: we offer a hybrid work schedule, with team members coming into the office twice a week. This allows you to engage directly with your team and experience the unique energy of our workspace, while still enjoying the flexibility and comfort of working from home. With flexible working hours and trust in your productivity, we are in sync with your team’s general locations and time zones to foster effective and seamless collaboration.

  • Virtual Shares - An ownership mindset in every role. We believe everyone should share in our success, and that’s why every employee receives Virtual Shares, linking your contribution directly to DeepL’s growth and rewarding you with a stake in our future.

  • Regular in-person team events: we bond over vibrant events that are as unique as our team, from local team and business unit gatherings, to new-joiner onboardings, to company-wide events that bring us all together–literally.

  • Monthly full-day hacking sessions: every month, we have Hack Fridays, where you can spend your time diving into a project you're passionate about and get the opportunity to work with other teams–we value your initiatives, impact, and creativity.

  • 30 days of annual leave: we value your peace of mind. With 30 days off (excluding public holidays) and access to mental health resources, we make sure you're as strong mentally as you are professionally.

  • Competitive benefits: just as our team spans the globe, so does our benefits package. We've crafted it to reflect the diversity of our team and tailored it to align with your unique location, to ensure you feel supported every step of the way.

If this role and our mission resonate with you, but you're hesitant because you don't check all the boxes, don't let that hold you back. At DeepL, it's all about the value you bring and the growth we can foster together. Go ahead, apply—let's discover your potential together. We can't wait to meet you!

#LI-JW2

We are an equal opportunity employer

You are welcome at DeepL for who you are - we appreciate authenticity here. Our product is for everyone, and so is our workplace. The more voices we have represented and amplified in our business, the more we will all succeed, contribute, and think forward! So bring us your personal experience, your perspectives, and your background. It’s in our diversity that we will find the power to break down language barriers in the world.

jobs.description:
About the role

Luminovo builds the software that powers the electronics supply chain — and we're building out the DACH side of our Global Solutions team. As a Solutions Engineer based in Munich or Berlin, you are the technical face of Luminovo at the two moments that decide whether a customer succeeds with us.

The Solutions team is one global team across Europe and the US, deliberately not split by region so knowledge doesn't get siloed. It's a unified team, which means real ownership: you won't inherit a finished playbook, you'll help write it.

What you'll do

  • Own customer onboarding end to end: tenant configuration, ERP and data integrations, end-user training, and driving each account to first value

  • Become the go-to expert for at least one Luminovo module, define its onboarding blueprint, and teach the rest of the Solutions team how to run it

  • Build deep expertise in the Luminovo platform and the electronics manufacturing landscape — deep enough that industry experts trust you in the room

  • Spot implementation risk early, escalate to the right people proactively, and keep projects on schedule

  • Turn what you learn into revenue-anchored feature requests and input for the Product team helping them to further improve our software.

Who you are

  • You speak German fluently and work comfortably in English. You'll be in front of technical buyers every week

  • You have a technical foundation and a track record of getting deep into an unfamiliar product fast. A degree in engineering, computer science, physics, or a related field helps — so does hard evidence that you taught yourself something difficult

  • You're process-driven. You're at your best when a project has gone sideways and someone needs to draw the map

  • You're comfortable in front of customers: you can hold your own in a technical conversation with a specialist, then explain the same thing simply to a procurement lead

  • You use AI as more than a better search engine. Ideally you've built your own automations, workflows, or tools — we care about what you've actually shipped, not what you've read them

  • Bonus: French language fluency

Work setup

Hybrid in Munich or Berlin. Munich is our global HQ; we also have a Berlin hub. No strict office policy, but a clear expectation of regular collaboration days with your Solutions teammates and colleagues across multiple departments.

Travel

We meet regularly for team retreats and selected industry events, so expect occasional travel. We cover the costs.

Why Luminovo

  • Join a well-funded SaaS scale-up with 300+ active customers, in the role that decides whether they succeed with us

  • One global Solutions team across Europe and the US — no EU/US knowledge silos

  • AI at the core of the product and of how we work, not a slide in a deck

  • Real ownership on a young team: define the blueprints the rest of the team runs on

🤓 Whom you'll be working with

  • Rachel, Global Solutions

  • Sam, Global Solutions

  • Seba, one of our founders, close to our OEM and go-to-market motion

  • Our Account Executives and Customer Success Managers across DACH, who'll pull you into their most technical conversations

  • Our Product Managers, so you understand the roadmap and constraints and can feed real customer signal back into it

⚡️ Skills, knowledge, and expertise

Just so you know – we purposefully did not create a standard list of minimum qualifications for this role. We care much more about your motivation and ability to help us accelerate technical progress than we care just about your CV. If you're interested to find out more about why we banned requirements from our performance profiles – see here.

⚡️ About Luminovo

Luminovo is the first electronics supply chain platform that unites all data, processes, and stakeholders in the trillion-dollar electronics industry.

We fundamentally believe that technology is the best tool that humankind has developed to tackle the biggest challenges we face as a society today. And we want to do our share in accelerating technological progress.

We bring innovations to life faster and cheaper by creating a more connected and resilient electronics supply chain.

To date, over 300 active customers worldwide are working with us towards this shared goal. Supported by leading investors such as Cherry Ventures, General Catalyst/LaFamiglia, Chalfen Ventures, and others, we have raised more than €20 million.

Our core principles: putting people first & building great things

As a remote-first company headquartered in Munich, our brilliant team is spread across cities including Munich, New York, Austin, Calgary, Berlin, London, Valencia, Nairobi, and Verona, among others. 🌍

Our team includes a mix of product enthusiasts, people advocates, business masterminds, and engineering experts. Among us are graduates from institutions like Stanford University and the University of Cambridge, as well as talented individuals with unconventional CVs. What matters most is their drive to build great things.

We provide an authentic environment based on psychological safety to empower Luminerds from various backgrounds to succeed, grow, and focus on impact. Putting people first means that we deeply care about who our employees are, what makes them unique, and what they excel at.
