jobs.title: Founding Product Success Manager, Head of CS Track
jobs.description:
About BoWatt

BoWatt is building agentic requirements and systems engineering software for manufacturing. We believe AI will reach PhD-level engineering capability within the next 10 years. This will unlock massive value across complex manufacturing industries. Cars. Planes. Rockets. Factories. Chips. Medical devices. All will be engineered with agents.

We bootstrapped BoWatt to €500k+ ARR before raising our first round. BoWatt is backed by tier-1 investors, including Atlantic Foodlabs, Buildery (CDTM affiliates), and Prequel Ventures, along with angels from Cohere and Luminovo.

You’ll join a small team of startup builders focused on speed, ownership, and execution. Over half the team are former founders, with backgrounds across DeepTech AI, gaming, and other startups. We’ve studied and worked at institutions and companies including Stanford, TUM, Google, EA, and YC-backed AI startups.

The role

As our Founding Product Success Manager, you will sit between our customers and product team. You will own customer success after the initial sale while also playing a hands-on role in shaping and improving the product.

This is not a traditional Customer Success role. You will work directly with customers, understand their problems in depth, and work with our engineers to turn those problems into product improvements.

  • Own the customer relationship after the initial sale, from onboarding through successful adoption and long-term partnership

  • Build strong relationships with users, champions, and senior stakeholders at large Mittelstand companies and Tier-1 enterprises in the DACH region and beyond

  • Spend significant time with customers to understand their workflows, problems, and product needs

  • Drive product adoption across customer teams and help users integrate BoWatt into their day-to-day engineering processes

  • Ensure customers get measurable value from BoWatt by regularly reviewing progress, identifying blockers, and developing practical solutions

  • Run operative product management for customer-driven improvements: understand problems, define requirements, create and prioritize tickets, and work closely with engineering through implementation

  • Test new features with customers, collect feedback, and iterate together with the product and engineering teams

  • Own customer-facing software incidents and bugs end-to-end, from initial investigation and reproduction through prioritization and resolution with engineering

  • Identify opportunities to expand BoWatt within existing customers across additional teams, use cases, and business units

  • Bring structured customer feedback into the product team and help shape our product roadmap

  • Build and improve our processes for onboarding, adoption, customer feedback, product discovery, and customer success

  • Develop deep expertise in BoWatt's software, customers, and target industries

During your first 6 months, you will work closely with our CPO and product team to develop the product, industry, and customer knowledge needed to gradually take ownership of increasingly complex customers and product initiatives.

You

  • You genuinely enjoy working with customers and building strong, long-term relationships

  • You enjoy getting into the details of customer problems and figuring out how the product can solve them

  • You write clearly, communicate confidently, and know how to get to the point with both technical users and senior stakeholders

  • You are highly structured and take ownership of driving projects and customer initiatives to completion

  • You can understand complex customer challenges and turn them into clear, practical solutions and product requirements

  • You are proactive: you identify risks and opportunities early rather than waiting for customers to raise them

  • You are comfortable working with technical B2B products and are curious about how engineering and manufacturing teams operate

  • You are comfortable working closely with software engineers and discussing bugs, features, priorities, and trade-offs

  • You want to grow into a domain expert across our software, customers, and industry

  • You are ambitious, resourceful, and willing to go the extra mile to make customers successful

jobs.description:
How will you make an impact?

As a Senior Full Stack Engineer, you'll work at the intersection of engineering and product to shape how our users build with Hygraph. You'll ship features that solve real customer problems, contribute to our CMS core, extend our platform capabilities, and help bring AI-powered features to life. You won't wait for perfect specs or pixel-perfect designs. You'll use your judgment, collaborate closely with product managers, designers, and customers, and move fast using modern AI-assisted development tools.

This role is for someone who sees engineering as a team sport, takes ownership without waiting for permission, and thrives in an environment where initiative matters more than instructions.

What you will be working on:

  • Core CMS development: Evolve the GraphQL-native CMS powering enterprise teams worldwide, improving performance, reliability, and developer experience.

  • CMS extensions and integrations: Develop and maintain extensions that expand what customers can do with Hygraph.

  • AI-powered features: Contribute to our AI roadmap by building intelligent capabilities into the product.

  • Customer-facing improvements: Use monitoring data, customer feedback, and your product instinct to identify and fix problems before they're reported proactively.

Some of your tasks and responsibilities:

  • Collaborate in a cross-functional, autonomous team to deliver features and continuous improvements, often working from rough prototypes or early concepts rather than polished designs.

  • Translate business needs into technical solutions by working closely with the Product team. Occasionally, participate in customer conversations to validate that what you're building actually solves their problems.

  • Comfortable using modern AI-assisted development tools (Cursor, Claude, Codex, or similar) to accelerate development.

  • Proactively identify issues through monitoring and observability data. Then fix them, don't just flag them.

  • Contribute to architectural decisions that keep our platform scalable, reliable, and maintainable.

  • Share what you know, learn from others, and help your teammates grow. Engineering here is collaborative. We win together.

Expectations timeline

1 Month

You'll complete onboarding covering our product, tech stack, infrastructure, and vision. You'll meet people across the company, get familiar with our codebase, and ship your first contributions. You'll start building context on how our customers use Hygraph and what matters most to them.

3 Months

You'll be delivering features and improvements to production with confidence. You'll have a solid understanding of Hygraph's product and architecture, and you'll be contributing ideas, not just code. You'll have built working relationships with your team lead, PMs, designers, and fellow engineers through regular 1:1s, operational reviews, and day-to-day collaboration.

6 Months

By now, you'll be making significant contributions to both the product and the team. You'll bring fresh perspectives from your experience and help raise the bar across performance, architecture, and how we work. You'll be someone the team relies on. Not because you do everything, but because you make everyone around you better.


What we expect from you:

Significant experience (typically 6+ years) building and owning production systems, with strong full-stack skills in JavaScript/TypeScript and deep backend expertise, scalability, and performance fundamentals (ideally Node.js).

  • Experience building user interfaces, ideally with React.

  • Experience developing well-tested APIs with GraphQL.

  • Solid knowledge of relational databases (especially PostgreSQL), including schema design and query optimization.

  • Active use of AI-assisted development tools (Claude, Cursor, Codex, or similar) in your workflow.

  • Familiarity with cloud-native development (AWS, GCP).

  • Experience with monitoring and observability tooling (New Relic, Datadog, or similar).

  • Openness and experience with on-call and operational work (investigations, incident response, etc.).

  • Ability to work with ambiguity: rough prototypes, evolving requirements, and imperfect information. You use judgment and experience to fill the gaps.

  • Strong product sense. You think about why you're building something, not just how. You care about the customer experience, not just the code.

Bonus points

  • Experience with Golang.

  • Knowledge of infrastructure as code tooling (Pulumi, Terraform).

  • Experience working directly with customers or in customer-facing roles.

  • Familiarity with headless CMS platforms or content infrastructure.

The Process

  • Intro call with People Team

  • Interview with the Hiring Manager

  • Technical Interview

  • C-Level Call and Reference Check (optional)

  • Job Offer

The response time after application, screening applications, and setting up the first intro call is usually within 1-2 weeks. You could expect some alterations when necessary.

About us

Hygraph is a dynamic Berlin-based startup and a GraphQL-native, API-first headless CMS built for teams delivering complex, composable digital experiences. Hygraph is on a mission to eliminate complexity for global teams and help them scale content without friction. Our platform empowers you to create, deliver, and distribute content faster and at scale. We’re a team committed to shaping the future of AI-powered content platforms. Trusted by over 50,000 teams worldwide, Hygraph powers structured content across websites, applications, product experiences, and AI-enabled systems.

As AI reshapes how digital experiences are created and operated, Hygraph is helping organizations build on structured, trusted content foundations that enable human-first, AI-accelerated experiences at scale. You will be part of a remote-first, globally distributed team committed to working collaboratively, transparently, and passionately. We believe in a remote-first approach where everyone is encouraged to do their best from wherever they are and work together with transparency, accountability, and ownership. We learn continuously through feedback and have a yearly learning budget to attend training and conferences.

Hygraph is an equal-opportunity employer committed to hiring people with diverse backgrounds. We believe that diversity, unique experiences, qualities, and different cultures enrich our workspace's productivity and promote innovation and creativity.

Note: We are fortunate to receive a large number of applications for our roles. To manage this effectively and give each application the attention it deserves, we use AI-assisted tools to help assess certain screening questions and handle application elements. This helps us ensure a consistent and timely review process. All final hiring decisions are made exclusively by our human recruitment team.

jobs.title: Senior IT Operations & Service Manager (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
Dein täglicher Verantwortungsbereich:

  • Der operative Betrieb unseres internen IT-Bereichs liegt in deinen Händen: Du packst selbst mit an, strukturierst Themen und sorgst dafür, dass technische Aufgaben pragmatisch umgesetzt werden.
  • Gemeinsam mit einem kleinen Team stellst du den zuverlässigen Betrieb unserer Office IT-Infrastruktur und unserer Microsoft-basierten Arbeitsumgebung sicher.
  • Bei technischen Fragestellungen gehst du lösungsorientiert vor, analysierst Ursachen und unterstützt aktiv beider Umsetzung.
  • IT-Projekte planst du strukturiert, priorisierst Aufgaben sinnvoll und bringst Themen gemeinsam mit internen Stakeholdern und externen Dienstleistern voran.
  • Externe Dienstleister steuerst du verbindlich und stellst sicher, dass Leistungen, Verantwortlichkeiten und technische Entscheidungen zu unseren Anforderungen passen.
  • Unseren IT-Support entwickelst du schrittweise zu einem strukturierteren Service-Modell weiter und übersetzt wiederkehrende Themen in klare Prozesse.
  • Jira Service Management gestaltest du gemeinsam mit dem Team als zentrale Plattform für Anfragen und Support weiter.
  • In IT- und Informationssicherheits-Audits sowie regelmäßigen Zertifizierungen sorgst du dafür, dass Prozesse, Verantwortlichkeiten und Nachweise sauber aufgebaut und gepflegt werden.


Deine Kompetenzen:

  • Du bringst fundierte praktische Erfahrung im Betrieb und in der Weiterentwicklung moderner IT-Umgebungen mit.
  • Microsoft-basierte Unternehmensumgebungen sind dir vertraut und du verstehst, wie eine sichere und skalierbare IT für ein wachsendes Unternehmen aufgebaut wird.
  • IT-Projekte kannst du strukturieren, Prioritäten setzen und unterschiedliche Aufgaben, Beteiligte und Abhängigkeiten zuverlässig zusammenführen.
  • Technische Lösungsansätze beurteilst du sicher und gehst bei Störungen pragmatisch, analytisch und umsetzungsorientiert vor.
  • Mit Microsoft 365, Entra ID und Intune hast du bereits gearbeitet.
  • Die Zusammenarbeit mit externen IT-Dienstleistern ist dir vertraut und du kannst technische Empfehlungen kritisch einordnen.
  • Erste Erfahrung in der fachlichen Anleitung von Kolleg:innenist hilfreich, aber keine Voraussetzung; wichtiger ist, dass du Verantwortung übernehmen und dich in eine Führungsrolle weiterentwickeln möchtest.
  • Deutsch und Englisch beherrschst du sicher und kommunizierst mit technischen Teams ebenso souverän wie mit nicht-technischen Stakeholdern.


Unsere Werte, dein Mindset:

  • Team First: Ein Team, ein Ziel - Gemeinsam sind wir stark. Wir wachsen durch gegenseitige Unterstützung.
  • Customer Success Is Our DNA: Identifiziere, hinterfrage und verfolge die Ziele Deines Kunden. Feiert gemeinsam den Erfolg.
  • Never Stop Reinventing: Sei offen für Neues und gehe Veränderungen mutig an. Hinterfrage Prozesse, liefere Lösungsvorschläge und neue Ideen.
  • Be Yourself And Make Goals Work: Sei Du selbst. Erreiche Großes!


Deine Benefits bei uns:

  • Remote Work: Flexibles Arbeitsmodell - arbeite bis zu 100 % remote innerhalb Deutschlands oder nutze unser modernes Office in Hamburg.
  • Urlaub: Mehr Zeit für das, was dir wichtig ist - zusätzlich zu 30 Urlaubstagen kannst du deinen Jahresurlaub durch Gehaltsumwandlung auf bis zu 40 Tage erhöhen.
  • Workation: Arbeiten, wo du dich inspirieren lässt - arbeite einmal pro Jahr remote aus dem europäischen Ausland. Nach zwei Jahren Betriebszugehörigkeit sind sogar weitere internationale Workation-Möglichkeiten möglich.
  • Gesundheit: Deine Gesundheit liegt uns am Herzen - mit unserer betrieblichen Krankenversicherung erhältst du ein jährliches Gesundheitsbudget für zahlreiche Gesundheitsleistungen. 
  • Dein Wahlbenefit: Du entscheidest, was am besten zu deinem Alltag passt - wähle zwischen einem Zuschuss zum Urban Sports Club, einem bezuschussten JobTicket oder einer Edenred-Sachbezugskarte für deine Einkäufe. 
  • JobRad: Ob für den Arbeitsweg oder deine Freizeit - lease dein JobRad über uns und profitiere von attraktiven steuerlichen Vorteilen. 
  • Altersvorsorge: Wir denken heute schon an morgen - sichere deine Zukunft mit unserer betrieblichen Altersvorsorge inklusive 20 % Arbeitgeberzuschuss. 
  • Verantwortung & Entwicklung: Raum für Eigeninitiative statt starrer Hierarchien - übernimm Verantwortung, bringe deine Ideen ein und gestalte die Zukunft der Reos Gruppe aktiv mit.
  • Networking: Zweimal im Jahr kommt die gesamte Reos Gruppe in Hamburg zusammen - freue dich auf unvergessliche Firmenevents, persönlichen Austausch und echte gemeinsame Erlebnisse.

jobs.title: Director, Global Field & Partner Marketing
jobs.description:
Meet DeepL

DeepL is a global AI product and research company focused on building secure, intelligent solutions to complex business problems. Over 200,000 business customers and millions of individuals across 228 global markets today trust DeepL's Language AI platform for human-like translation, improved writing and real-time voice translation.
Founded in 2017 by CEO Jaroslaw “Jarek” Kutylowski, DeepL now has around 1,000 passionate employees and is supported by world-renowned investors including Benchmark, IVP, and Index Ventures.

Our goal is to become the global leader in trusted, intelligent AI technology, building products that drive better communication, foster connections, and create a meaningful impact. To achieve this, we need talented people like you to join our journey. If you’re ready to shape the future of AI and grow your career in a fast-moving, purpose-driven environment, DeepL is your next destination.

What sets us apart

What sets us apart is our blend of cutting-edge AI technology, meaningful work, and a culture where people truly thrive. We’re a team of innovators, researchers, and creators driven by a shared purpose to unlock human potential by making work simpler, smarter, and more connected.

When we share what it’s like to work at DeepL, the reactions are overwhelmingly positive. This might be because of our technology that helps millions of people and businesses communicate and work better every day, or because of the trust, curiosity, and care that shape our culture.

What we know for sure is this: being part of DeepL means joining a team dedicated to innovation, growth, and well-being. Discover more about life at DeepL onLinkedIn,Instagram, and our Blog.

Meet the team behind this journey

DeepL is at an inflection point in its growth, and this is a rare opportunity to shape how the world's most accurate AI translation company engages enterprise customers, creates pipeline and scales through partners globally. As Director of Global Field & Partner Marketing, you will own two tightly integrated functions: a global field and events programme spanning owned, third-party and executive formats, and a partner marketing capability that activates DeepL's growing ecosystem of channel, technology and integration partners.

You will lead a distributed team of regional field marketers and partner marketers across EMEA, APJ (dotted line) and North America, unifying them under a single commercial strategy that is directly accountable to pipeline creation, deal acceleration, adoption and expansion revenue.

This role reports directly to the VP of Demand Generation and sits at the heart of DeepL's go-to-market motion.

Your responsibilities

GLOBAL FIELD MARKETING & EVENTS

  • Own and scale DeepL's global field marketing programme across owned events, third-party conference activations, executive engagement formats and digital programmes - driving net new pipeline, deal acceleration and product adoption across mid-market and enterprise segments.

  • Define and manage the global field marketing strategy, ensuring programme investment is allocated to the highest-return formats and markets and adjusted in response to pipeline signals and sales priorities.

  • Lead the evolution of DeepL's flagship owned programme portfolio scaling them across new cities and regions while maintaining quality, commercial rigour and local relevance.

  • Build and scale an executive engagement capability in close partnership with Sales and Customer Success, creating access to senior decision-makers within priority accounts through intimate, high-value formats.

  • Partner with Sales, SDR, Revenue Intelligence and Marketing Ops to establish rigorous measurement frameworks covering pipeline sourced, pipeline influenced, speed-to-lead and closed-won attribution - and use these insights to drive continuous programme optimisation.

  • Champion a culture of commercial accountability: every programme format is evaluated against pipeline outcomes, and investment decisions are made on evidence, not habit.

PARTNER MARKETING

  • Lead DeepL's partner marketing function, developing and executing co-marketing strategies with channel partners, technology partners, GSIs, ISVs and integration partners that generate measurable pipeline and expand DeepL's market reach.

  • Build scalable co-marketing frameworks - including joint event programmes, partner-led demand generation, marketplace activations and partner enablement content - that allow partners to market DeepL effectively within their own networks and customer bases.

  • Own partner-attached pipeline targets and contribution to ARR, ensuring partner marketing programmes are designed to drive measurable commercial outcomes rather than activity metrics.

  • Partner closely with the Partnerships, Sales, Product Marketing and Creative Studio teams to develop partner-specific messaging, assets and campaign frameworks that reflect DeepL's positioning while enabling partner customisation.

  • Develop and manage the partner marketing calendar globally, with clear accountability for joint pipeline targets, co-investment frameworks and performance reporting.

  • Continuously evolve the partner marketing operating model to support DeepL's growing partner ecosystem, including emerging opportunities with hyperscalers, marketplace listings and developer community programmes.

LEADERSHIP & CROSS-FUNCTIONAL COLLABORATION

  • Lead, inspire and develop a high-performing, globally distributed team of field marketers and partner marketers, fostering a culture of commercial accountability, creativity and continuous improvement.

  • Serve as the key marketing partner to Sales, SDR, Customer Success, Product Marketing and Partnerships leadership - aligning field and partner activity directly to pipeline targets, territory plans and revenue objectives.

  • Represent field and partner marketing at senior leadership level, clearly articulating strategy, programme performance, investment rationale and regional market insights.

  • Build and maintain strong operating cadences with Sales leadership across all regions, ensuring tight alignment on target account lists, programme priorities and follow-up execution.

Qualities we look for

  • 12–15 years of experience in field marketing, events and/or partner marketing, with significant time spent in B2B SaaS — ideally within a global scale-up of 500+ employees.

  • Demonstrated success building and scaling owned event programmes - including executive engagement series, flagship conferences and multi-city roadshows - with direct accountability for sourced and influenced pipeline outcomes.

  • Proven track record in partner marketing, including co-marketing programme design, partner enablement and partner-attached pipeline generation across channel, technology and GSI partner ecosystems.

  • Strong AI literacy, with hands-on experience leveraging AI tools to scale field marketing operations, automate campaign execution workflows and improve programme ROI - including use cases across event setup automation, content personalisation, lead scoring and follow-up cadence management.

  • Proven ability to embed AI into field marketing operating models, driving efficiency gains, faster execution cycles and improved pipeline outcomes.

  • Experience leading and developing a geographically distributed team of 6+ marketers across multiple regions, with a track record of building strong team cultures and developing regional marketers into senior contributors.

  • Deep familiarity with the enterprise B2B buying cycle - including the interplay between field-sourced pipeline, SDR follow-up, sales acceleration and partner-influenced revenue.

  • Exceptional commercial instincts: you are comfortable owning pipeline targets, interpreting SFDC attribution data and using programme performance insights to influence investment decisions at the leadership level.

  • Strong cross-functional instincts - you are a natural collaborator who can align Sales, Partnerships, SDR and Product Marketing around shared field and partner priorities without formal authority.

jobs.title: Head of Customer Operations
jobs.description:
Want to join a team of passionate people who want to build a future where no one dies from skin cancer?

👋 About us

Skin Analytics is an award-winning, health tech company that deploys world-leading skin cancer pathways using AI as a medical device, DERM.

Following our recent £15M series B funding, regulatory milestones hit, and doubling from 50 to 100 headcount in 2025, we're ready to scale further internationally, making history for AI in healthcare and the future of dermatology.

We're proud to epitomise AI for good - with a Class III CE mark, DERM is the only AI as a medical device approved to make clinical decisions autonomously in the cancer space, as well as being the first company to receive a NICE recommendation for use across the NHS.*

DERM is deployed at more than 28 NHS organisations where we enable patients to gain significantly quicker access to skin cancer diagnosis. If that's not enough, we also collaborate with some of the largest health insurers to reach patients in their own homes.

We are a team of passionate people on a mission to build a future where no one dies from skin cancer.

Overview
You'll own the operational delivery of our transformational services from implementation through to ongoing live operations, ensuring our partners and patients receive a consistently excellent experience. You'll also be the person the business trusts to contain and resolve operational noise like incidents, service disruptions, partner escalations, logistics failures - calmly and methodically.

At the core of the role are two customer-facing teams:

  • Transformation (7 headcount with two intermediary senior roles) owns the change management journey to implement our AI technology into NHS and international and insurance partners. This spans pre-sale governance, through to pathway design, training and go-live as well as working on discrete post launch projects as agreed with Commercial.

  • Client Operations (5 headcount, including one Team Lead) covers support for NHS and international clinical users as well as the full patient-facing layer of our B2B2C model: support, data requests, hardware management, and the logistics of mailing diagnostic kits to patients, making it the team our patients interact with most directly.

  • You'll also manage a single Office Administrator who keeps the business running day-to-day, though this sits outside the core customer operations remit.

The right person for this role will be process-obsessed in the best sense: someone who is passionate about solving inefficiency, reaches for data and systems, and knows where AI and automation can remove friction from the customer journey and internal processes. You'll need enough grounding in data protection and clinical governance to make sound operational decisions in a regulated environment, and the judgement to know when to escalate.

Responsibilities

  • Own the end-to-end operational performance of Skin Analytics' customer delivery function, ensuring partners and patients receive a safe, reliable and scalable service from implementation through live operation.

  • Act as the main cross functional point of contact for the Operations function, agreeing ways of working with Commercial, Clinical, Regulatory, Product and Engineering teams to ensure smooth day to day working. Also act as the senior Operational escalation point for major partners.

  • Build and refine the processes, playbooks and tooling that enable each team to operate consistently as we scale, while continually improving customer time-to-value, service quality and partner satisfaction.

  • Define the metrics and reporting cadences that give leadership visibility without constant escalation.

  • Lead, coach and develop the Transformation and COT teams through their managers and directly, setting clear expectations and holding teams to them while providing the support they need as we scale.

  • Champion digital and AI adoption within your teams, identifying opportunities to automate or augment work and building the capability to do so.

  • Maintain operational practices consistent with our data protection, clinical governance and regulatory obligations, in partnership with our DPO, Clinical and Regulatory teams.

  • Identify and mitigate operational risks before they become incidents; when they do, own the response and retrospective.

  • Oversee the Office Administrator and our external IT vendor, ensuring the workplace and facilities run smoothly without requiring senior attention.

Required Experience

  • Excellent stakeholder management: credible at senior level internally and trusted by external partners, clear and direct in communication.

  • Proven experience running multi-team customer operations at scale - you’ve managed complex functions, not just coordinated them.

  • Exceptional process and systems thinking - you build repeatable, scalable ways of working for client supporting teams and have low tolerance for avoidable inefficiency.

  • A track record of incident and crisis management: calm under pressure, methodical in response, and effective at containing operational issues without escalating them unnecessarily.

  • Strong line management experience, including managing through team leads and developing operational managers.

  • Data-driven: you measure what matters, spot problems in the numbers before they surface elsewhere, and prioritise accordingly.

  • A bias for action and ownership - you don’t wait to be asked, and you don’t leave ambiguous problems to someone else.

  • Background in health tech, healthcare or an adjacent regulated industry

Nice to have

  • Hands-on experience embedding AI or automation into operational workflows - either personally or by leading teams to do so.

  • A strong understanding of data protection obligations and clinical governance requirements.

  • Change management expertise, particularly in complex B2B or B2B2C environments.

Benefits

💰 Competitive salary

📈 Share options package - all our employees have ownership in the company

🏥 Private healthcare

💸 Company pension incl. salary sacrifice options

🌴 25 days annual leave + 5 day company shutdown in August + bank holidays

👪 Enhanced parental leave - includes adoption & foster

🚲 Bike to work scheme

💻 Training budget

🤝 Weekly catch-ups, monthly meetings to talk about you, your ambitions and work on your development

🎊 Lots of fun social activities!

Our Values

🌱 Building a Strong Foundation

🎓 Always Learning

🏅 Lead from the Front

💪 Tough and Resilient

The Real Stuff

jobs.description:
About Us 

IVC Evidensia is the UK and Europe’s leading veterinary care group, made up of over 900 practices and referral hospitals, united by a shared purpose of happier animals, happier owners. 

At IVC Evidensia, we believe careers should be built without limits. Our people are supported to make more impact, access more career opportunities, and play an active role in their local and professional communities. Through investment in learning, innovation, and wellbeing, we create environments where our teams can grow in confidence, capability, and fulfilment—at every stage of their career. 

As part of Central Functions, you will be part of the teams that support and enable our network of over 2,500 practices across 20 countries, driving operational excellence, innovation, and strategic impact across the business.  

Our Technology teams are responsible for the systems and infrastructure that make that work - everything our healthcare professionals need to deliver world-class care. From keeping on top of patient records, health plans, client communications, diary management and dispensing, our teams have a lot to think about and need smarter ways to provide the convenience and expertise that modern Pet owners have come to expect.

IVC Evidensia is undergoing an exciting digital transformation. The key to this is improving the management of our core data sets - accelerating the standardisation of operational systems in practices, building stronger master data management tooling, and developing standard reporting models across the group.

As a data engineer, you will work with the team to advance the data platform within a DevOps culture. You will play a central role in building and maintaining scalable data pipelines across Databricks & Azure SQL Server, and will bring solid experience with ELT, orchestration, and scripting languages. A firm grasp of data modelling and management will be essential throughout.

The role

The Data Engineer will be a technical authority accountable for the design and development of the technologies that underpin our data strategy. At the heart of this is our Databricks data platform, and you will take ownership of building, optimising, and maintaining data pipelines using PySpark - orchestrating feeds from source systems through to our group data platform and taking technical ownership of all parts of the process.

You will work closely with the business to deliver solutions that address real challenges, engaging with SMEs to break requirements into deliverables. You will also collaborate with the Data Architect to shape our overarching data management strategy.

What you'll bring to the role

We're looking for a technically skilled and business aware individual with a strong understanding of data concepts, including storage, processing, and modelling. Core requirements include:

  • Databricks - hands-on experience building and managing workloads on the Databricks platform, including Delta Lake, Unity Catalog, and Declarative Automation Bundles
  • PySpark - proficiency in writing and optimising PySpark code for data transformation and processing
  • Azure - solid experience working within the Azure ecosystem, including services such as Azure Data Factory, Azure Data Lake Storage, and Azure DevOps
  • Azure SQL Server - experience with Azure SQL Server is important, as it forms the foundation of our existing data warehouse. You will be working across both our SQL Server environment and our Databricks platform, and an understanding of how the two integrate will be key to success in this role
  • ELT & pipeline development - experience designing and maintaining pipelines using REST APIs, JSON, and ELT protocols
  • Data modelling - comfort working with both relational and non-relational data technologies, with a solid grounding in modelling principles

Exposure to business intelligence tools like Power BI is desirable. You'll act as a key interface between IT and functions such as Finance and Marketing, so excellent communication and stakeholder engagement skills are vital.

You should be confident working within an Agile framework, with an understanding of secure development practices and non-functional requirements such as scalability, performance, and access management. An international mindset, sensitivity to local business priorities, and a collaborative approach are essential.

What’s in it for you? 
At IVC Evidensia, we’re committed to supporting your development and wellbeing.

When you join us, you’ll benefit from: 
A role with real business impact supporting teams across the organisation 
Clear career pathways with progression opportunities within Central Functions and beyond 
Ongoing learning and development supported by tailored programmes and resources 
A collaborative, values-led culture focused on care, innovation, and continuous improvement 
Flexible working with a remote first working policy

Benefits 
Healthcare Cash Plan 
Cycle to Work scheme 
Green Cars salary sacrifice scheme 
Voluntary benefits: choose from a range of benefits to suit you 
Discounted staff pet care  
Access to discounts/cashback with hundreds of participating retailers 
 
Diversity, Equality, Inclusion and Belonging 
At IVC Evidensia we are committed to Diversity, Equality, Inclusion and Belonging, we are keen to hear from candidates from all minority and diverse groups. As a Disability Confident Employer, we are keen to hear from candidates with disabilities and long-term health conditions and would be happy to discuss any reasonable adjustments needed during the recruitment process.

jobs.title: (Senior) Consultant Business Value Chain
jobs.description:
Das findest Du bei uns

Bei Eraneos unterstützen wir Unternehmen dabei, komplexe Herausforderungen zu meistern und eine nachhaltige, digitale Zukunft zu gestalten. Als Consultant in unserem Manufacturing & Operations Team begleitest Du führende Unternehmen bei der erfolgreichen Umsetzung von Veränderungs- und Transformationsvorhaben. In interdisziplinären Projektteams arbeitest Du an strategischen und operativen Fragestellungen, baust wertvolle Branchen- und Methodenexpertise auf und unterstützt unsere Kunden dabei, ambitionierte Ziele in messbare Geschäftsergebnisse zu übersetzen.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Du unterstützt Transformations- und Optimierungsprojekte in den Bereichen Manufacturing, Supply Chain und Engineering
  • Du analysierst Geschäftsprozesse und operative Leistungskennzahlen, identifizierst Verbesserungspotenziale und unterstützt fundierte Entscheidungsprozesse
  • Du wirkst an der Entwicklung von Target Operating Models, Governance-Strukturen und Transformations-Roadmaps mit
  • Du unterstützt Strategie- und Optimierungsinitiativen in den Bereichen Manufacturing, Supply Chain und Operations
  • Du wendest Methoden des Lean Managements und der kontinuierlichen Verbesserung an, um Effizienz, Qualität und Unternehmensergebnisse nachhaltig zu steigern
  • Du erstellst hochwertige Kundenpräsentationen und unterstützt Workshops, Stakeholder-Management sowie die Umsetzung von Projektaktivitäten


Das bist Du

Du bist analytisch, kommunikativ und arbeitest gerne im Team? Neben einem hohen Maß an Eigeninitiative und einer ausgeprägten Hands-on-Mentalität zeichnen Dich folgende Qualifikationen aus:

  • Mindestens 2 Jahre Berufserfahrung in der Managementberatung mit Fokus auf Transformations- und Optimierungsprojekte in Manufacturing-, Supply-Chain- oder Engineering-Umfeldern
  • Erfolgreich abgeschlossenes Studium der Ingenieurwissenschaften, Betriebswirtschaftslehre, Volkswirtschaftslehre oder eines vergleichbaren Studiengangs
  • Verständnis für operative Prozesse, kontinuierliche Verbesserungsmethoden sowie Transformationsvorhaben in industriellen Umfeldern
  • Ausgeprägte Kommunikations- und Präsentationsfähigkeiten sowie die Fähigkeit, unterschiedliche Stakeholder erfolgreich einzubinden
  • Verhandlungssichere Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse
  • Reisebereitschaft entsprechend den Anforderungen unserer Kundenprojekte


Das sind wir

Eraneos ist eine internationale Management- und Technologieberatung mit Fokus auf Strategie, Transformation und Technologie. Wir unterstützen Unternehmen dabei, in einer dynamischen digitalen Welt erfolgreich zu sein. Mit erstklassigen Expertinnen und Experten aus Business und Technologie befähigen wir unsere Kunden, neue Maßstäbe für nachhaltige Transformation zu setzen – von der Strategie bis zur Umsetzung. Ob bei der Gestaltung zukunftsfähiger Organisationen, der Erschließung neuer Potenziale durch Daten und Künstliche Intelligenz oder der Absicherung von Unternehmen durch umfassende Cybersecurity-Lösungen: Wir liefern pragmatische und nachhaltige Ergebnisse mit messbarem Mehrwert.

Unser Team aus rund 1.300 Mitarbeitenden arbeitet an Standorten in Deutschland, der Schweiz, den Niederlanden, Spanien, Dänemark, Schweden, Österreich, dem Vereinigten Königreich, Singapur, Japan und den USA. Dabei verbinden wir internationale Perspektiven mit einer starken lokalen Verankerung.

Neben spannenden Projekten in einem internationalen Umfeld bieten wir ein hohes Maß an unternehmerischer Freiheit und vielfältige Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten. Unsere Unternehmenskultur ist geprägt von Wertschätzung, Zusammenarbeit und gegenseitiger Unterstützung. Wir fördern individuelle Karrierewege durch gezielte Weiterentwicklung und Mentoring. Unsere Mitarbeitenden stehen für uns im Mittelpunkt – deshalb bieten wir attraktive Vergütungspakete sowie zahlreiche zusätzliche Benefits.


So erreichst Du uns

Für Fragen vorab steht Dir Patricia Herbst –  oder +49 40 809 081-172 - zur Seite. 

Unsere oberste Priorität ist, dass Du zu uns passt und wir zu Dir, unabhängig von Herkunft, Nationalität, sexueller Orientierung, Religion, Geschlechtsidentität, Alter, Handicap oder anderen Aspekten der Vielfalt.

Bewerbe Dich gerne über unser Unternehmensportal mit Deinem CV und / oder Deinem aktualisierten Xing bzw. Linked In Profil.

Interessiert es dich, was unsere Mitarbeitenden und andere Bewerber/innen über uns sagen? Besuche uns auf Kununu und folge uns auf Social Media, um die aktuellsten News über uns nicht zu verpassen.

jobs.title: SEO / GEO Lead (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
1KOMMA5°

Bei 1KOMMA5° verfolgen wir eine Vision: Living on wind and sunlight forever for free. Dafür bauen wir mit Heartbeat AI das Energiesystem der Zukunft. Bist du dabei?
Wir bringen regionales Handwerk und skalierbare Software zusammen: Solar, Speicher, Wärmepumpe und E-Mobilität denken wir nicht einzeln, sondern steuern sie als intelligentes, integriertes Gesamtsystem in unserem virtuellen Kraftwerk. Direkt verbunden mit dem Strommarkt – in Echtzeit, vollautomatisiert. So wird Energie dann genutzt, wenn sie erneuerbar verfügbar und besonders günstig ist. Bis 2030 wollen wir 1,5 Millionen Haushalte auf erneuerbare Energien umstellen. Über 3.000 Menschen arbeiten jeden Tag daran, an mehr als 80 Standorten weltweit, von Finnland bis Australien.

Du willst Verantwortung übernehmen und Lösungen bauen, die wirklich zählen? Bewirb dich jetzt und gestalte mit uns die Energiewelt von morgen.

Deine Position

  • Strategie & internationale Steuerung: Du entwickelst die globale SEO- und GEO-Strategie, priorisierst über Märkte hinweg und setzt Ziele entlang des Funnels: von Sichtbarkeit über qualifizierte Anfragen bis zum Beitrag auf den CAC. Die Teams in den Ländern machst du mit klaren Briefings und gemeinsamen Standards handlungsfähig. Ihre Insights fließen zurück in die Strategie
  • Team, Agenturen & Freelancer: Du führst ein kleines Team, entwickelst es fachlich weiter und baust es mit deinen Anforderungen aus. Agenturen und Freelancer steuerst du inhaltlich und wirtschaftlich, vom Briefing über die Qualität bis zum Budget
  • Content-getriebener Organic Growth: Du baust Organic-Growth-Modelle auf und bringst sie in neue Märkte, von Keyword- und Wettbewerbsrecherche über die Content-Roadmap bis zur Qualitätssicherung auf der Website. Die Content-Strategie verantwortest du gemeinsam mit den Content Managern im Department: Du bringst die Search-Perspektive ein, sie den redaktionellen Blick
  • GEO & AEO (Modern Search): Du richtest unsere Inhalte so aus, dass sie in KI-gestützten Suchergebnissen sichtbar sind, machst diese Sichtbarkeit messbar und leitest daraus die nächsten Schritte ab
  • AI-Workflows, Daten & Technik: Du baust automatisierte SEO-Prozesse mit LLMs und Tools wie n8n oder Make, für Briefings, Content-QA und Monitoring. Mit Search Console, Ahrefs, Screaming Frog und GA4 hältst du die Website technisch sauber und übersetzt Auffälligkeiten direkt in Maßnahmen
  • Du verantwortest SEO und GEO für alle Märkte von 1KOMMA5°, von Finnland bis Australien. Klassische Suche und AI Search denkst du dabei zusammen: Was in der Google-SERP funktioniert, muss auch in ChatGPT, Perplexity und den AI Overviews ankommen. Dafür baust du content-getriebene Organic-Growth-Modelle, die über Märkte hinweg tragen, und automatisierst mit KI alles, was sich automatisieren lässt
  • Du übernimmst ein kleines Team und formst es weiter. Und du bleibst nah an der Arbeit: Strategie schreiben und selbst in den Crawl gehen sind hier kein Widerspruch

Dein Profil

  • Erfahrung & nachgewiesenes Wachstum: 6+ Jahre SEO (Inhouse oder Agentur), davon Erfahrung in einer Rolle mit strategischer Verantwortung oder über mehrere Märkte hinweg. Du hast content-getriebene Organic-Growth-Modelle aufgebaut und verantwortet, nicht nur umgesetzt. Deinen Erfolg misst du an qualifizierten Leads und am Beitrag zum CAC, nicht an Rankings und Sessions. Wenn organischer Traffic steigt, aber keine Anfragen daraus entstehen, ist das für dich kein Erfolg
  • Führung & Steuerung: Du hast schon Menschen geführt oder fachlich angeleitet und externe Dienstleister gesteuert. Ein kleines Team zu entwickeln reizt dich mehr, als ein großes zu verwalten
  • Daten & Tools: Du beherrschst die gängigen SEO- und Analytics-Tools sicher und triffst Entscheidungen auf Basis von Daten, nicht auf Basis von Bauchgefühl
  • AI-Affinität & Modern Search: Du arbeitest täglich mit LLMs, hast Automatisierungen selbst gebaut und verfolgst die Entwicklung von AI Search so genau, dass du Veränderungen früh erkennst und einordnest
  • Hands-on & Zusammenarbeit auf Augenhöhe: Du denkst strategisch, gehst aber auch selbst ins Sheet, in den Crawl oder ins Briefing. Und du bringst Menschen hinter eine Richtung, die dir nicht unterstellt sind: mit Argumenten, Klarheit und Verlässlichkeit
  • Du sprichst fließend Deutsch und Englisch (C-Level)

Benefits

  • Du hast die Möglichkeit in unseren brandneuen Büros in der Hamburger Innenstadt, Berlin &München zu arbeiten und/oder remote
  • Nutze dein technisches Equipment auch abseits der Arbeit in deiner Freizeit
  • Du bist Teil eines schnell wachsenden Unternehmens mit viel Entwicklungspotenzi al, wo du eigenständig etwas aufbauen kannst und deinen Impact spürst
  • Bewege dich in flachen Hierarchien, übernimm schon während deiner Einarbeitung Verantwortung und arbeite direkt mit Teilen des Managements zusammen

Mein Kunde ist eine PE-finanzierte, europaweit stark wachsende Unternehmensgruppe mit mehreren tausend Mitarbeitenden und klarer Buy-&-Build-Strategie. über 150 Partnerunternehmen an mehr als 100 Standorte. Getragen von zwei renommierten Private-Equity-Investoren verfolgt die Gruppe eine klare Buy-&-Build-Strategie und baut sich gezielt zum technologie- und KI-gestützten Makler und Assekuradeur um. Die Mission: Europas führenden KI-gestützten Versicherungsmakler aufbauen, mit AI-Lösungen, die die Unternehmen der Gruppe produktiver machen, bessere Entscheidungen ermöglichen und Kunden einen spürbaren Mehrwert bieten.

Dafür wird gerade ein komplett neues, zentrales AI-Team mit direkter COO-Anbindung aufgebaut. Parallel zu dieser Rolle werden die Forward Deployed AI Engineers gesucht, mit denen du zusammenarbeitest. Für die Investoren ist KI kein Kostenfaktor, sondern zentraler Werttreiber, entsprechend stehen Budget und Rückhalt des gesamten Management Boards dahinter.

Du verantwortest die AI-Transformation eines kompletten Geschäftsbereichs, End-to-End: entweder im Maklergeschäft oder im Assekuradeursgeschäft der Gruppe. Du bist regelmäßig unterwegs zu den Häusern, sprichst mit den lokalen Geschäftsführern, verstehst ihre Abläufe und treibst von dort aus die Transformation voran. Du nimmst Prozesse auf, denkst sie mit KI neu und sorgst dafür, dass Lösungen nicht nur gebaut, sondern wirklich genutzt werden. Die Rolle verlangt jemanden, der strukturiert denkt, Menschen bewegt und sich zwischen Geschäftsführerebene und operativem Alltag gleichermaßen sicher bewegt.

Ehrlich gesagt: Vieles entsteht hier gerade erst, Strukturen, Standards, Spielregeln. Wenn du fertige Prozesse suchst, ist das nichts für dich. Wenn du sie bauen willst, schon.

Aufgaben

  • End-to-End-Verantwortung: Du identifizierst, priorisierst und realisierst AI-Use-Cases für deinen Geschäftsbereich, von der ersten Idee über die Steuerung aller Stakeholder bis zum produktiven Einsatz und zur Verankerung in der Organisation.
  • Prozesse neu denken: Du nimmst bestehende Geschäftsprozesse auf, hinterfragst sie kritisch und entwirfst sie mit KI von Grund auf neu, nicht nur effizienter.
  • Strategischer Ansprechpartner: Du übernimmst die Beziehung zu den lokalen Geschäftsführern und Fachbereichsleitern, bist ihr primärer Ansprechpartner für KI-Transformation und treibst die organisatorische Verankerung der Lösungen voran.
  • Engineering-Koordination: Du koordinierst die Forward Deployed AI Engineers, die deine priorisierten Use Cases technisch umsetzen, und stellst sicher, dass Lösungen im Alltag ankommen.
  • Gruppenweite AI-Strategie: Du gestaltest die AI-Strategie der gesamten Gruppe aktiv mit und bringst die Erfahrungen aus deinem Bereich in die zentrale Roadmap ein.

Qualifikation

  • Ausbildung und Erfahrung: Abgeschlossenes Studium auf Bachelor- oder Master-Niveau oder vergleichbare Qualifikation, dazu mindestens 4 bis 6 Jahre in Transformation, Unternehmensberatung, Projektmanagement oder im Start-up-Umfeld.
  • Projektsteuerung: Du hast nachweislich komplexe Projekte mit mehreren Stakeholdern gesteuert und weißt, wie man Interessen ausbalanciert, ohne das Ziel aus den Augen zu verlieren.
  • Prozessanalyse und -design: Du weißt, wie man Prozesse strukturiert aufnimmt, bewertet und neu konzipiert, und übersetzt das in priorisierte, umsetzbare Roadmaps.
  • Technisches Verständnis: Du bewegst dich sicher zwischen LLMs, Schnittstellen und modernen AI-Architekturen, genug, um mit den AI Engineers auf Augenhöhe zu arbeiten, ohne selbst coden zu müssen.
  • Unternehmerisches Mindset und Kommunikation: Du kommunizierst souverän auf allen Ebenen bis C-Level und denkst in Ergebnissen statt in Zuständigkeiten.
  • Sprachen: Deutsch auf muttersprachlichem Niveau, Englisch verhandlungssicher für internationale Einheiten, Investoren und externe Partner.

Benefits

  • Schlüsselrolle: Die KI-Transformation eines kompletten Geschäftsbereichs in einer der größten Makler- und Assekuradeursgruppen Europas, mit echtem unternehmerischem Gestaltungsspielraum.
  • Direkter Zugang: Enge Zusammenarbeit mit dem C-Level der Gruppe und den Geschäftsführern der einzelnen Unternehmen, kurze Entscheidungswege inklusive.
  • Umsetzungskraft: Eigene Engineers, die bauen, was du priorisierst, statt Empfehlungen, die in Schubladen landen.
  • Umfeld: Ein hochmotiviertes, unternehmerisch denkendes Team, das schnelles Lernen und eigenverantwortliches Handeln belohnt.
  • Flexibles Arbeiten: Hamburg bevorzugt, alternativ Köln, Frankfurt oder München, 3 bis 4 Tage remote möglich, regelmäßige Präsenz in den Häusern der Gruppe.
  • Attraktives Gehaltspackage mit ca. 15-20% variablem Anteil, freier Hardwarewahl und einem individuell abgestimmten Benefitpackage

Was die Rolle sonst noch prägt

  • Fachliche, nicht disziplinarische Führung: Engineers, externe Partner und virtuelle Projektteams werden auf ein Ziel hin geführt – ohne Weisungsbefugnis, auch gegenüber den Geschäftsführern der Häuser.
  • Wirkung über den Business Case: Niemand wird von oben zur Umsetzung verpflichtet. Überzeugt wird im Dialog und über Zahlen. Wer sich trotzdem sperrt, wird nicht bekämpft – man weicht auf das nächste Haus aus. Bei echtem Stillstand steht das Group Management Board dahinter.
  • Präsenz in den Häusern: Regelmäßige Reisetätigkeit, zu Beginn erhöht. Kredibilität entsteht vor Ort.
  • Hands-on-Anteil: Kein tiefes Coden gefordert, aber Augenhöhe mit Engineers und im Idealfall die Fähigkeit, einen MVP selbst hochzuziehen – wegen des Tempos.
  • Fingerspitzengefühl: Effizienzgewinne bedeuten später, dass bei Mehrgeschäft nicht automatisch mehr eingestellt wird. Das muss fair und nachvollziehbar platziert werden.

Shaping the data architecture. You design logical and physical data models, map data flows and lineage across systems, and make the structural decisions that determine how data is organised, integrated, and consumed. Advising and translating. You sit at the intersection of technology and business.   • Experience with data modeling, data architecture, or designing data flows and integration patterns across systems
  • Experience designing or operating data governance, security controls, and platform observability in environments serving multiple teams or domains
  • Demonstrated ability to collaborate with diverse stakeholders including engineers, analysts, product owners, and business leaders in client-facing settings


Preferred Qualifications

  • Depth in enterprise data architecture, including conceptual, logical, and physical modeling, data lineage, and approaches such as dimensional modeling or Data Vault
  • Hands-on experience with multi-tenant platform design or multi-cloud environments

About the Role: 

We're looking for a Lead Data Engineer to join TodayTix Group and own how we scale our data platform — the backbone connecting product, growth, finance, and CX to a single source of truth, plus increasingly the substrate AI tooling across the company queries directly. You'll lead the team that owns the project end-to-end — staging, intermediates, and marts — plus the CI/CD pipeline and Snowflake platform underneath it.

This is a technical leadership role, not a heads-down modelling one — most of your time goes to architecture, review, technical strategy, and cross-functional leadership, with hands-on modelling a deliberate minority. You lead by setting direction, raising the team's bar, and owning delivery, quality, and stakeholder trust across a high-demand roadmap.

The foundation is built — your job is what gets built on top of it as the org scales. TTG is expanding as part of MARI, bringing new portfolio companies' event and ticketing data onto the platform; PxT (our partner-facing product) is growing its surface area; and the business keeps adding markets and brands. You'll design how the platform absorbs that growth — new sources, new consumers, higher stakes — without the architecture buckling.

If you thrive in a fast-moving, high-ownership environment, measure your impact by the team's, not just your own, and care as much about business impact as technical craft, we'd love to hear from you — especially if, like the rest of the team, you reach for AI by default.

Please note: This full-time position and qualified candidates must be based in the Greater London area. We encourage collaboration by working a minimum of 2 days per week in the office, with flexibility to choose where you work for the rest of the week.


What Success Looks Like:

  • The platform scales, it doesn't strain → New portfolio events, new surfaces, and new markets onboard onto the existing staging/intermediates/marts pattern without one-off hacks or a rebuild.

  • Data people trust by default → Certified marts stay accurate and documented as volume and source count grow; breaking changes get caught by CI and dbt tests, not discovered by a stakeholder in a dashboard.

  • A faster, more autonomous team → Engineers ship models confidently without you reviewing every line; your reports are visibly levelling up.

  • Architecture that holds → Your design decisions — dynamic tables vs. incremental models, how a new portfolio company's data enters the model, orchestration choices — hold up as sources and consumers multiply, and design flaws get caught in review, not production.

  • Trust through ownership → Stakeholders across product, growth, finance, and CX bring you problems, not tickets, because you communicate early and their reporting hasn't broken under them.


    • What You'll Do:

  • Own the data platform end-to-end — the dbt project (staging → intermediates → marts), CI/CD, and the Snowflake infrastructure it runs on.

  • Design and lead the onboarding of new data sources onto the platform as TTG scales, so growth doesn't mean architectural debt.

  • Partner with data consumers — product, growth, finance, CX, and incoming portfolio teams — to model new sources cleanly rather than bolt them on under deadline pressure.

  • Run intake and prioritisation across a high-demand roadmap where reporting, growth analytics, and AI-tooling initiatives compete for the same team's time — sequence against business objectives, and say no well.

  • Protect data quality systematically — dbt tests, contract-enforced schemas, and CI that catches breaking changes before they reach a dashboard or an AI agent.

  • Set technical direction for the warehouse and give the kind of code review that makes data engineers better — spotting model design flaws before they ship.

  • Lead and grow the team — 1:1s, feedback, and career development.

  • Build the factory, not just the models: keep pushing AI into how the team works, and support the org's growing use of AI agents as direct consumers of the warehouse you build.


    • We're Looking for Someone With:

  • A track record of leading engineers. 8+ years in data engineering (or software engineering with a heavy data bent), including leading a team — formally or informally — and growing the engineers around you. This is the core of the role.

  • Deep SQL and dbt expertise. You've built and scaled a dbt project in production — models, tests, macros, contracts — and reason about warehouse cost and performance, not just correctness.

  • Cloud data warehouse depth. Hands-on experience with Snowflake or a comparable MPP warehouse (Redshift, BigQuery).

  • Experience scaling a data platform through growth — onboarding new business units, acquisitions, or data sources onto an existing model without rearchitecting from scratch. (M&A / multi-entity data integration experience is directly relevant given the evolving company structure.)

  • Full-stack data platform judgement. Comfortable across ingestion (CDC/replication from operational databases, event pipelines), transformation (dbt), and consumption (BI tools, reverse ETL, AI/agent access) — even where you're not the one writing every layer.

  • Strong architecture and code review. You set technical direction through sound data-model design and give review that makes engineers better.

  • Stakeholder management. You partner with product, finance, growth, and CX — translating messy source data into models people trust, and setting expectations as priorities shift.

  • A product and business mindset. You measure success by the decisions your data enabled, not rows modelled.

  • AI fluency. You already reach for AI to write and review data models, and you're comfortable with AI agents as first-class consumers of the warehouse you build.

Das sind wir.

Fitness-Tracker zeigen uns buchstäblich auf Schritt und Tritt, wie es um unsere Bewegungsbilanz steht. Bei Cheftresor dreht sich alles um Innovation und Fortschritt. Unsere Mission: Unternehmen und Steuerberater mit smarten Softwarelösungen zu stärken und ihre Zusammenarbeit grundlegend zu transformieren. Als junges Unternehmen, das gleichzeitig auf über 30 Jahre Erfahrung im Bereich Buchhaltung und Controlling zurückgreift, entwickeln wir Tools, die echten Mehrwert schaffen.

Doch Innovation allein ist nicht alles – wir setzen genauso auf ein wertschätzendes und motivierendes Arbeitsumfeld, in dem sich jeder individuell entfalten kann. Bei uns steht Teamwork an erster Stelle: keine Ellenbogenmentalität, sondern ein agiles Miteinander, das Veränderung bewirkt und Türen öffnet.

Klingt nach dir? Dann freuen wir uns auf dich!

Das erwartet dich.

Als Senior Frontend Entwickler (m/w/d) sorgst du dafür, dass aus komplexen Daten ein Produkt wird, das gerne genutzt wird. Das bringst du mit.

Wir suchen jemanden, der nicht nur coden, sondern auch mitdenken möchte. Du solltest sehr eigenverantwortlich arbeiten können und Spaß daran haben, Lösungen zu entwickeln, die unsere Kunden wirklich weiterbringen. Darüber hinaus findest du dich in folgenden Punkten wieder:

  • Du arbeitest eigenverantwortlich, strukturiert und mit einem klaren Qualitätsanspruch.

Unser Team ist unser größtes Kapital, und das soll auch so bleiben. Deshalb sorgen wir dafür, dass du dich bei uns wohlfühlst und weiterentwickeln kannst. Bei uns erwarten dich:

jobs.title: Principal Product Designer
Engineering Manager
jobs.description:
Your mission

As Engineering Manager at Cosuno, you will lead a team of full stack engineers while staying deeply hands-on: you'll spend 60–80% of your time coding, reviewing, and shaping the architecture alongside your team. You are the kind of leader who elevates a team by example — writing code that sets the bar, and building an environment where great engineers do their best work.

Your mission might include:

  • Leading a team of full stack and AI/ML engineers: coaching, regular 1:1s, growth plans, and hiring — while shipping product yourself every week.

  • Owning the delivery and technical quality of your team's roadmap, working closely with your Product Manager to plan, de-risk, and execute.

  • Contributing hands-on across our TypeScript stack (React + Node), from designing features to reviewing pull requests and tackling the hard problems yourself.

  • Raising the team's technical bar through code reviews, architectural guidance, and best practices — including driving the adoption of AI-assisted engineering workflows.

  • Partnering with engineering leadership on team topology, processes, and the technical direction of our platform.

How We Build: Our Engineering Culture

We believe in a calm, collaborative, and productive engineering environment. We trust our engineers and give them the autonomy to do their best work. Our approach includes:

  • Agile & Fast-Paced: We practice trunk-based development with daily releases to get value into our users' hands quickly.

  • Quality by Default: We maintain a comprehensive Cypress E2E test suite and enforce strict typing, linting, and formatting rules to keep our codebase clean and maintainable.

  • DevOps Mindset: Our well-oiled CI/CD pipeline deploys to AWS via Kubernetes, with our entire infrastructure managed as code using Terraform.

  • Collaboration & Transparency: We value open discussion, constructive code reviews, and a culture where the best idea wins, regardless of who it comes from.

Your profile

We're looking for a player-coach: a strong engineer who leads people without giving up the keyboard. You'll be a great fit if you have:

  • Extensive experience (typically 7+ years) in software engineering, with a proven track record of delivering complex, scalable web applications.

  • Strong expertise in our core technologies (TypeScript, Node.js, React) and the ability to reason about the entire stack, from the database to the browser — and you still use it daily.

  • Leadership experience — whether as an Engineering Manager or team lead with direct reports, or as a senior tech lead who has mentored engineers, led projects, and shaped how a team works.

  • A genuine desire to keep coding: this role is 60–80% hands-on by design, and that's what excites you about it.

  • A passion for growing people. You find joy in helping other engineers develop, in giving honest feedback, and in building a healthy, high-performing team.

  • Bonus, not required: a good understanding of building LLM-based applications or ML algorithms — your team includes AI/ML engineers, and being able to follow their work helps, though you won't need to be the expert.

  • Excellent communication skills in English, with the ability to articulate complex technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences.

Why us

  • Competitive Compensation: A competitive salary above the market average.

  • Work-Life Balance: Choose to work 100% remotely or from our modern office in Berlin. We offer flexible working hours to fit your life.

  • Top-Notch Equipment: A new MacBook Pro to ensure you have the best tools for the job.

  • A Great Team: Regular company off-sites and team events that connect us as people, not just colleagues.

  • Job Security: A permanent contract in a stable, well-funded company.

About us

Cosuno – Revolutionizing construction through technology.

We are Cosuno – a fast-growing tech startup that is making the construction industry more efficient and transparent with our digital platform for tenders and procurement processes. Our goal: to solve the most complex challenges in the industry with innovation and simplicity.

Why Cosuno?

Artificial intelligence is the key to our solution: it analyzes millions of price data points and helps construction companies create precise and efficient bids. This not only saves our customers time but also helps them avoid unnecessary costs.

But for us, it's not just about technology – it's about the people who drive it. At Cosuno, you will work with creative minds who are reshaping the construction industry. We believe in diversity because we know that the best ideas come from different perspectives. An integrative and inclusive work environment is a matter of course for us.

Join us – Build the future of construction.

Location: 100% remote (EMEA, CET±2), with team gatherings in person a few times a year
Hours: Full-time, 40 hours per week
Pay: €60.000 to €90.000 annually, adjusted by experience and location

At Miaplaza, we build homeschool platforms that kids aged 4–18 actually want to use — Miacademy, MiaPrep, and our Online High School are serving over 150.000 students today. Our product foundations are strong. What we want next is a step change in how our products feel: more expressive illustration, more purposeful motion, more moments of craft that turn a lesson into something a kid remembers.

We're hiring a Senior Product Designer whose craft anchor is illustration and motion. Our design team is small and senior, five designers when you join, and each brings a distinct strength: brand, design systems, research, and now yours

The role

You'd own product design for the student learning experience end-to-end: from problem framing through delivery, in a Product Trio with a PM and EM who have strong opinions and expect yours. This is product work with real trade-offs — pedagogical, technical, and business — and you're accountable for how it lands, not just how it looks.

Beyond Curriculum, you'd set the illustration and motion bar for all of Miaplaza: the standards, motion principles, and character direction that the other designers and the design system build from.

A defining part of the role is art-directing AI-assisted production. You'd build the prompts, references, and review process that let a small team produce quality illustration and motion at a scale hand-crafting alone can't reach. We don't expect you to know every current tool — we expect the taste and judgment to direct output rather than accept defaults.

You'd report to the Head of UX, with regular 1:1s covering craft, product, and career growth. The direction is upward: deeper craft leadership, cross-product influence, or both.


You must have all of these to be considered:

  • A portfolio of shipped digital product work — not only concepts or standalone pieces

  • At least 2 years working inside a product team, collaborating with PMs and engineers

  • Strong illustration or motion skills, with at least 1 year focused on either as a primary craft

  • Proficiency in Figma

  • Some experience directing or guiding visual work produced by others — freelancers, junior designers, or AI tools

You’ll stand out if you also have:

  • Deep motion skills in product contexts: interactions, transitions, onboarding, character animation

  • Experience using AI image or motion tools as production accelerators

  • Confidence running your own usability research, not just receiving findings

  • Multi-brand or education-focused design experience

  • Accessibility practice, especially for neurodivergent audiences

This probably isn’t right for you if:

  • Your work hasn't yet lived inside a live product with real constraints

  • You prefer well-scoped tasks over shaping ambiguous problems

  • You see AI tools as either a threat to craft or a shortcut around it

Our hiring process

As a remote company, we receive a large number of applicants, and finding the best fit for this role is our top priority — that’s why our process is longer than usual. At every stage, we try to be respectful of your time and grateful you’re spending it with us.

  1. Application and eligibility check — work authorization, timezone, availability

  2. Async assessment — 12 scenario-based, multiple-choice questions (~30 min) + when qualifying; 3 open questions (max. 45 min)

    1. If you pass the multiple choice section, you will asked to complete 3 open written questions (max. 45 min)

  3. Portfolio review — the design team will review your best work and thinking

  4. Behavioral interview — a conversation with our People team about how you work

  5. Take-home design task — ~60 minutes, scoped for this role, AI tools encouraged

  6. Hiring team interview — with a design team member and the Head of UX

  7. Skip-level conversation — with executive leadership

  8. Reference checks

We give honest, timely feedback at every step. Job searches are hard; we don't want to make yours harder.

Compensation and setup

The pay range for this role is €60,000 - 90,000. Miaplaza’s compensation philosophy ensures equity and competitiveness while considering regional differences in labor costs. Placement within a range is determined based on factors such as demonstrated skills, internal equity, and local labor market rates for the candidate’s geographic area.

Miaplaza is a growing, self-funded EdTech company. We're an equal opportunity employer and welcome applicants from all backgrounds. If you need accommodations at any point in the process, just let us know.

DeepL is a global AI product and research company focused on building secure, intelligent solutions to complex business problems. Over 200,000 business customers and millions of individuals across 228 global markets today trust DeepL's Language AI platform for human-like translation, improved writing and real-time voice translation.
Founded in 2017 by CEO Jaroslaw “Jarek” Kutylowski, DeepL now has around 1,000 passionate employees and is supported by world-renowned investors including Benchmark, IVP, and Index Ventures.

Our goal is to become the global leader in trusted, intelligent AI technology, building products that drive better communication, foster connections, and create a meaningful impact. To achieve this, we need talented people like you to join our journey. If you’re ready to shape the future of AI and grow your career in a fast-moving, purpose-driven environment, DeepL is your next destination.

What sets us apart

What sets us apart is our blend of cutting-edge AI technology, meaningful work, and a culture where people truly thrive. We’re a team of innovators, researchers, and creators driven by a shared purpose to unlock human potential by making work simpler, smarter, and more connected.

When we share what it’s like to work at DeepL, the reactions are overwhelmingly positive. This might be because of our technology that helps millions of people and businesses communicate and work better every day, or because of the trust, curiosity, and care that shape our culture.

What we know for sure is this: being part of DeepL means joining a team dedicated to innovation, growth, and well-being. Discover more about life at DeepL onLinkedIn,Instagram, and our Blog.

Meet the team behind this journey

At DeepL, we're on an exciting adventure to expand our operations to match our ambitious growth plans. At the heart of this journey is our Sales team, a cornerstone of DeepL's market expansion and customer engagement strategy.

Our mission is clear: to build and develop high-performing sales teams that embody DeepL's innovative spirit and drive for excellence. As a member of our Sales team, you will be at the forefront of driving our growth and expanding our global reach. Working in close partnership with Marketing, Product, and Customer Success teams, you will collaborate to deliver tailored solutions that meet the needs of our clients.

Your responsibilities

  • Own territory design globally — coverage models, segmentation, and account assignments — across the annual planning cycle, working directly with sales managers and our regional Sales Strategy Business Partners.

  • Model and monitor. Build territory and ownership scenarios across Salesforce, Google Sheets, and Databricks, then track how territories perform once they're live: which patches are working, what's selling where, and where coverage needs rebalancing.

  • Build target-account strategies grounded in our product, partnering with Product, Data Analytics & Insights, and Marketing Operations to sharpen our ICP by region and focus coverage where it's most likely to convert.

  • Own our sales policies and Rules of Engagement — where reps can and can't sell, how ownership decisions get made, and what happens when the rules are breached. These exist today; rebuilding them properly is yours.

  • Automate the manual work. This role is roughly 40% operational today and we want it closer to fully strategic. You'll have our backing to use AI tools like Claude, and the partnership of our Systems and Operations teams, to get it there.

  • Keep the foundations clean. Be the strategy voice in Salesforce roadmap reviews so changes don't quietly break territories or reporting, and handle day-to-day account reallocation as people join, move, and leave.

Qualities we look for

  • Around 3–5 years in Sales Operations, Revenue Operations, Go-to-Market Strategy, or sales planning. We care more about what you've owned than the number on your CV.

  • Highly analytical. You're comfortable getting into the data across Sheets, Salesforce, and Databricks to test an idea, and you land on a clear, defensible recommendation rather than a deck of options.

  • Confident reasoning about Salesforce — how accounts, territories, ownership, and data fit together. This is not an admin or technical role, and we have strong Systems and Operations teams behind you, but you need to hold your own in those conversations. Hands-on backend experience is a bonus, not a requirement.

  • Able to influence without authority. A lot of the change you'll drive sits in other teams, so you'll get there through insight, evidence, and constructive challenge.

  • A strong bias to automate. You already use AI tools such as Claude to remove repetitive work, or you have a genuine appetite to learn how.

  • Proactive. You spot the problem, work out what to do about it, and go and do it. We don't need someone who arrives with all the answers — we need someone who goes and finds them.

  • Comfortable with real deadlines. Planning season doesn't move and it's intense. The rest of the year is calmer and more about building for the next cycle.

  • Experience in tech at scale is a plus — somewhere you've seen what good looks like and can bring that standard with you.

  • Collaborative across regions and disciplines, with the energy and drive to work well with Sales, Product, Revenue Intelligence, and Marketing Operations.

What we offer

  • Diverse and internationally distributed team: joining our team means becoming part of a large, global community with people of more than 90 nationalities. We're more than just colleagues; we're a group of professionals with a shared mission to connect diverse cultures. Our global presence is growing–we've doubled in size nearly every year, with our employees based in the UK, Germany, the Netherlands, Poland, the US, and Japan, and we continue to expand our network.

  • Open communication, regular feedback: as a language-focused company, we value the importance of clear, honest communication. We value smooth collaboration, direct and actionable feedback, and believe that leading with empathy and growth mindset makes us better together.

  • Hybrid work, flexible hours: we offer a hybrid work schedule, with team members coming into the office twice a week. This allows you to engage directly with your team and experience the unique energy of our workspace, while still enjoying the flexibility and comfort of working from home. With flexible working hours and trust in your productivity, we are in sync with your team’s general locations and time zones to foster effective and seamless collaboration.

  • Virtual Shares - An ownership mindset in every role. We believe everyone should share in our success, and that’s why every employee receives Virtual Shares, linking your contribution directly to DeepL’s growth and rewarding you with a stake in our future.

  • Regular in-person team events: we bond over vibrant events that are as unique as our team, from local team and business unit gatherings, to new-joiner onboardings, to company-wide events that bring us all together–literally.

  • Monthly full-day hacking sessions: every month, we have Hack Fridays, where you can spend your time diving into a project you're passionate about and get the opportunity to work with other teams–we value your initiatives, impact, and creativity.

  • 30 days of annual leave: we value your peace of mind. With 30 days off (excluding public holidays) and access to mental health resources, we make sure you're as strong mentally as you are professionally.

  • Competitive benefits: just as our team spans the globe, so does our benefits package. We've crafted it to reflect the diversity of our team and tailored it to align with your unique location, to ensure you feel supported every step of the way.

If this role and our mission resonate with you, but you're hesitant because you don't check all the boxes, don't let that hold you back. At DeepL, it's all about the value you bring and the growth we can foster together. Go ahead, apply—let's discover your potential together. We can't wait to meet you!

You are welcome at DeepL for who you are - we appreciate authenticity here. Our product is for everyone, and so is our workplace. The more voices we have represented and amplified in our business, the more we will all succeed, contribute, and think forward!
